#493. Google DeepMind analysis proves Signal and WhatsApp encryption is secure

📅 10 Nov 2026

Google DeepMind analysis proves Signal and WhatsApp encryption is secure

Tanggal: 10 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://9to5mac.com/2026/11/10/google-deepmind-analysis-proves-signal-and-whatsapp-encryption-is-secure/

Diungkapkan bahwa the signal protocol has long been considered the gold standard for end-to-end encrypted messaging, with edward snowden a notable advocate. Now a Google DeepMind analysis has “formally verified” the security of the protocol.

In addition to its use in the Signal app, the same protocol is also used by WhatsApp and Google Messages, and the work has been described as “a landmark development” ….

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “formal verification” is the term given to mathematically proving or disproving that a cryptographic algorithm or protocol satisfies its security claims under all conditions. It guarantees that there is no situation in which the protocol will fail. This is a far higher standard than traditional testing methods which seek to find vulnerabilities but cannot promise that others do not exist.

Sebagaimana diketahui, using agentic ai to carry out formal verification is a huge breakthrough for cryptography and ai alike. It is, however, extremely computationally demanding, so Google told Wired it’s unclear as yet how practical it will be to use it more broadly.

Sebagaimana diketahui, deepmind researchers emphasize that their findings are just one milestone in a larger process. “We are very excited by this result, but there is a long distance to go before we are able to scale this to all the software of the world, and we want to do that,” Swarat Chaudhuri, a DeepMind research scientist, tells WIRED.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it’s important to note that the validation is for the protocol itself rather than the signal app as a whole. However, encouragement can be taken from the fact that when tested against older versions of Signal that contained known vulnerabilities, it identified those and flagged them as failing formal verification.

Berdasarkan laporan, also worth stating is that google was able to build on some past formal verification work already completed without the use of ai. This analysis took four weeks, and the scale of resources required has not yet been disclosed, so we shouldn’t expect a whole array of other protocols to be validated overnight. All the same, this is a very big deal.

Sebagaimana diketahui, for someone like me, who lives in a one-bedroom new york city apartment and tries not to think about whether or not i'll ever be able to afford a down payment, the apple homeview is an awesomely unnecessary sidekick. Sebagaimana diketahui, for upper-income homeowners, the homeview is a beautiful digital butler for the modern smart abode. #495. Rocco Classic Smart Fridge Review: A Cool Conversation Piece

📅 12 Nov 2026

Rocco Classic Smart Fridge Review: A Cool Conversation Piece

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.wired.com/review/rocco-super-smart-fridge/

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, updated november 2026: the rocco super smart fridge is now called the rocco classic, after rocco released two new fridges in 2026, the lower-priced essential and desktop-sized mini mini. Copy has been updated to reflect the new moniker.

Opening up someone else’s kitchen refrigerator is an intimate act.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i for one would prefer my guests don’t go in there for a beer and see the raspberries that are probably moldy, revealing a dark side of my personality. I’ll just get their drink for them. Having a separate mini fridge just for drinks can help, and when I saw how fresh and innovative the Rocco seemed, I had to know more.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the rocco classic feels more like a piece of furniture sitting in my living room, as opposed to a regular mini fridge, which often looks like it’s out of a college dorm, or a more industrial-looking regular wine fridge. I have the matte graphite color (it also comes in white, green, brown, and mirror-black).

Berdasarkan laporan, the whole thing is mostly made of steel, which makes it strong and heavy, and the rounded edges give it more of a soft appeal. It seems to be engineered very well, with quality materials, which I’m sure is why it costs as much as it does. This should last me a very long time in my home. Overall, it’s a beautiful statement piece that people who like to host in their home will love, but the features that make this a smart fridge are not perfect.

Sebagaimana diketahui, a typical wine fridge will generally fit full-size bottles of wine only, but the classic can fit 77 12-ounce cans (though rocco's website says 88) or 27 wine bottles in its 34. There are six shelves, each of which is designed so you can store bottles and cans of any size and stagger them to fit like a puzzle. 5 x 24 x 16-inch body (H x W x D). Each shelf is also reversible so the grooves match whichever shape bottles you choose to place on each shelf.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the rocco connects to an app on your phone (currently available only for ios; rocco hopes to have an android version at some point). It really is extremely quiet. The app is simple and easy to use, but there aren’t that many things to do on it, and some of the features feel forced. I keep mine on Quiet Mode. First of all, there are a few modes you can control from the app. I rarely hear much of a rumbling noise from the compressor compared to other fridges.

Diungkapkan bahwa similarly, there’s smart mode, which makes it work more like a thermostat when the fridge is sitting in a warmer temperature. There’s also Party Mode, which prioritizes keeping the drinks cold more so than making less noise. I opened it a few minutes later, and it was definitely colder in there. (Rocco gives the temperature range as 37 to 64 degrees Fahrenheit. After a few minutes, I did hear the compressor get a little louder. ).

#501. The Polar Vortex Is About to Make Weather Weird From the UK to the US

📅 12 Nov 2026

The Polar Vortex Is About to Make Weather Weird From the UK to the US

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.wired.com/story/the-polar-vortex-is-about-to-make-weather-weird-from-the-uk-to-the-us/

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a critical blockade against some of nature’s coldest air has temporarily broken down—and much earlier in the year than normal. Disruptions in this circulation, known as the polar vortex, often push intensely cold air out of the Arctic toward lower latitudes.

Sebagaimana diketahui, experts still aren’t entirely sure how the current collapse will play out in our everyday weather. But it’s another sign that we may be in for a wild ride over the weeks and months to come.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the polar vortex is a band of upper-level winds wrapping around the arctic circle like a dam. This circulation is usually strong and stable, helping to keep the season’s coldest air locked near the North Pole. But the winds occasionally weaken or even reverse course, which can set off an atmospheric chain reaction, allowing bitterly cold air to spill southward.

Berdasarkan laporan, the manner in which the polar vortex breaks down determines what kind of weather conditions we might expect. Upper-level winds dipping southward in troughs are responsible for brief spells of cold temperatures. These “lobes” of the polar vortex, as they’re known, are relatively common in a typical winter.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, sometimes, this circulation can splinter into smaller pieces. If the vortex were a flowing river, these fragments are like leaves stuck on the riverbank, forcing extremely cold air to linger over the same areas for days or weeks at a time.

Berdasarkan laporan, one such case made this phenomenon a household name. Chicago recorded its coldest February in nearly 140 years. A highly disrupted polar vortex in early 2015 sent a weeks-long burst of cold air sweeping over the eastern US. In Lexington, Kentucky, temperatures bottomed out at –18 degrees Fahrenheit, as subfreezing air dove all the way to the Gulf of Mexico.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, seeing a breakdown of the polar vortex this early in the season is unprecedented in the historical record. Disruptions of this extent typically don’t occur until the latter half of winter. Based on the latest data, the circulation’s reversal began on Tuesday, and computer model guidance expects it to last through Thursday.

Berdasarkan laporan, weather patterns take a few weeks to respond to a polar vortex disruption, if at all. Given that reliable forecasts only extend about 10 days into the future, we can’t know where in the northern hemisphere cold air from the Arctic may spill.

While experts are still debating the exact causes driving this polar vortex breakdown, the event throws another wrench into a cool season already dominated by another unprecedented event: the strongest El Niño on record.

Historically warm sea surface temperatures in the eastern Pacific Ocean have already significantly affected conditions around the world, and this influence will only grow heading into the winter months.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, much of north america can expect warmer-than-normal conditions during a winter dominated by a strong el niño. But every event is different, and now with a sudden disruption in the polar vortex, those forecasts are less certain, because unexpected things can happen when unprecedented phenomena overlap.

#502. Canadian court certifies class action against Apple over Google search deal

📅 10 Nov 2026

Canadian court certifies class action against Apple over Google search deal

Tanggal: 10 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://9to5mac.com/2026/11/09/canadian-court-certifies-class-action-against-apple-over-google-search-deal/

Sebagaimana diketahui, a british columbia supreme court judge has certified a class action against apple over allegations that its search agreement with google stifled competition and inflated advertising prices. Here are the details.

In recent years, Apple’s deal with Alphabet to make Google the default search engine on Safari has drawn regulatory attention in the US, the UK, and Australia, while related search competition concerns have also come under scrutiny in the EU and Japan.

While the details of each investigation differ, they all raise concerns about the impact of Google’s dominance in search, as well as the extent to which its agreements with other companies might be limiting competition.

Sebagaimana diketahui, more recently, apple’s agreement with google received significant attention during the us department of justice’s antitrust case against the search giant, which included testimony from apple executives eddy cue and john giannandrea. The latter joined Apple from Google in 2018 and led its AI efforts until stepping down earlier this year.

As a result of the US case, a federal judge ruled in August 2024 that Google had illegally maintained its monopoly in online search through anticompetitive agreements, including its deal with Apple.

Now, evidence presented during that trial has become central to a class action against Apple in Canada, which a British Columbia Supreme Court judge recently certified.

Berdasarkan laporan, the case was initially brought in 2021 by spark event rentals ltd. , an event rental company based in British Columbia. The plaintiff alleged that Apple and Google conspired to limit competition in the search market, allowing Google to charge advertisers artificially inflated prices.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, apple, meanwhile, argued that its agreement with google was a legitimate distribution arrangement rather than an unlawful conspiracy. The company also maintained that Google was the appropriate defendant, describing itself as an “innocent bystander. ”.

Interestingly, the lawsuit originally named both Apple and Google as defendants, but the plaintiff later dropped Google from the case following a dispute over an arbitration clause in its advertising contracts.

With Apple now the sole defendant, Justice Thomas has allowed the case to proceed as a class action, finding sufficient grounds to examine whether Google’s payments discouraged Apple from developing its own search engine.

The lawsuit seeks financial compensation for advertisers who allegedly overpaid for Google search ads, and the court has also allowed the question of punitive damages to proceed.

The class action covers Canadian residents who purchased search ads from Google since 2005, when Apple and Google first agreed to make Google the default search engine on Safari in exchange for a share of advertising revenue.

Importantly, the ruling does not establish that Apple engaged in anticompetitive conduct, but simply allows the allegations to proceed as a class action.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the central proposition raised by these pleadings is that apple could have used its resources and distribution network to enter the search engine market, but chose not to because google paid apple billions of dollars in revenue-share payments to make google the default search provider on apple products. This arrangement gave Google market power, enabling it to charge supracompetitive advertising prices on search engines.

In my view, this pleads a common purpose to perform an act prohibited by s 45 of the Competition Act, such that it is not “clear and obvious” that the plaintiff has not pleaded an agreement between Google and Apple not to compete in the search engine market.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, at one point in his decision, justice thomas cites giannandrea’s testimony and directly quotes cue’s from the us antitrust trial, before concluding that “this provides some basis in fact, supporting the inference that apple did not compete with google in the search engine market because of its agreement with google. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, interestingly, the judge also acknowledges apple’s objections to the evidence, agreeing that “the plaintiff has cherry-picked evidence to support his case,” but adding that, in his view, “it is appropriate to do so at this stage in the proceedings. ”.

With the class action greenlit, the case can now move forward toward trial, though no date has been announced yet.

#504. Three Ways to Avoid CAPTCHA Prompts When Using a VPN

📅 06 Nov 2026

Three Ways to Avoid CAPTCHA Prompts When Using a VPN

Tanggal: 06 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://lifehacker.com/tech/how-to-avoid-captcha-prompts-when-using-a-vpn?utm_medium=RSS

Diungkapkan bahwa vpns make it harder to track your online activity across websites, but it also makes them suspicious about your origins. When you borrow an IP address that hundreds of other people are also using for any number of reasons, you’re much more likely to get repeat verification requests from online firewalls.

Sebagaimana diketahui, that said, you don’t have to keep clicking on those traffic lights over and over. You can simply switch to a more reputable VPN server. Moreover, browsers now offer persistent access tokens to eliminate CAPTCHA requests, while VPNs offer dedicated IPs to keep sites from getting suspicious. Here are three easy fixes for repeat CAPTCHA prompts when using a VPN, so you don’t have to trade convenience for online privacy.

Diungkapkan bahwa captchas are simple puzzles that websites use to filter out bots and spam. They’re supposed to be easy for people but hard for robots, such as simple object recognition tasks or audio-visual challenges. However, they can still disrupt your browsing experience if they happen too frequently.

Berdasarkan laporan, most modern captcha providers, like google's recaptcha v3 or cloudflare turnstile, start working long before they give you a puzzle to solve. It usually starts with a risk score that studies your IP address, browser and device signals, or recent online activity.

Sebagaimana diketahui, if the captcha provider can’t confidently identify your request as human based on those signals, it requests that you complete a puzzle before deciding if the request should be blocked. For example, popular VPN servers spread the same IP address across any number of users, which can easily make a website mistake you for a bot farm. That means when you get repeat CAPTCHA requests, there’s something affecting your browser’s risk score. If you change your IP address frequently by switching servers often, that might look suspicious too.

Diungkapkan bahwa luckily, there are ways to deal with frequent captcha requests using tools and services available with your browser and vpn. Cloudflare has already cut its CAPTCHA requests by 91% using its Managed Challenge platform. Apple has also been shipping token-based verification on devices since iOS 16 and macOS Ventura. In June 2026, Cloudflare even announced a joint effort called the Private Access Control Tokens (PACT) standard with Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and Shopify.

Sebagaimana diketahui, while there’s no direct off switch for captchas, you can use different fixes to improve your browser’s trust signals when using the internet. That way, you’re less likely to be hounded by verification requests.

Diungkapkan bahwa the easiest fix for repeat captchas is to stop connecting to whichever server your vpn app picks automatically. I'd also skip big traffic hubs like New York or London, since that's where most traffic originates from. Proton recommends choosing servers with lower traffic load. In fact, its apps display load as a percentage to help you avoid the most crowded options. Servers in smaller cities located nearby are often just as fast but never as populated.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, you should also avoid changing ip addresses too frequently, which can look suspicious on its own. Also remember you’re more likely to get premium server options if you’re on a paid VPN plan. Pick a server that seems to behave well, then continue using it for at least one session. Major platforms like ExpressVPN, Surfshark, Proton, and Nord are particularly likely to have a larger server collection to pick from.

Costs nothing more than your current subscription.

Hopping between servers often can backfire.

Sebagaimana diketahui, private access tokens (pat) let you verify the authenticity of your request using your device rather than an ip address. Apple calls it Automatic Verification, where an Apple server validates your device and Apple Account to assign you an anonymous token.

Berdasarkan laporan, to enable automatic verification on an iphone or ipad, go to settings > [your name] > sign-in & security > automatic verification. On a Mac, open System Settings > [your name] > Sign-In & Security > Automatic Verification.

Diungkapkan bahwa unfortunately, there’s no equivalent feature for windows, android, and linux users. That said, Cloudflare offers the Silk extension for Chrome, Firefox, and Edge that serves a similar function. A quick look at the ratings will tell you it’s not as effective, but Cloudflare’s upcoming cross-browser standard called PACT seems promising once it is released.

Doesn’t share personal details with websites.

Chrome and Firefox extensions can be unreliable.

Berdasarkan laporan, if you pay a bit extra for a dedicated ip add-on, vpn providers can assign you a unique ip address that isn’t shared with anyone else. For example, NordVPN offers dedicated IPs in 30 countries for $2-5 a month and Surfshark charges $3. 75 a month for it.

Diungkapkan bahwa there are also dedicated providers like private internet access, which charges $3. 99 per month for a zero-trust setup so not even their employees know which IP address is assigned to you. On the other hand, Proton VPN offers dedicated IPs only to business plan users, so you’ll need to be on the Workspace Standard, Premium, or Enterprise plans to get one.

Berdasarkan laporan, that said, there is a trade-off here too. NordVPN itself admits that a dedicated IP makes it easier to link online activity back to a single user. Also, many websites can still tell that the IP address originated from a VPN data center rather than a consumer’s device.

Get unique IP addresses with pristine reputation.

Works across desktop, mobile, and even smart TVs.

Also functions as an allowlisted address for work.

Add-ons cost more on top of the VPN subscription.

Offers less anonymity than shared VPN servers.

Apple Intelligence completes regulatory registration for iPad and Mac in China

Tanggal: 09 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://9to5mac.com/2026/11/09/apple-intelligence-completes-regulatory-registration-for-ipad-and-mac-in-china/

Sebagaimana diketahui, apple has completed an important regulatory step ahead of apple intelligence’s expected launch in china this december. Here are the details.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in late october, apple published a press release on its chinese newsroom website confirming its intention to launch apple intelligence in china this december, as part of ios 27. 3.

Sebagaimana diketahui, apple went on to release the first ios 27. 3 developer beta a few days later, allowing users in China to test Apple Intelligence ahead of its public launch.

In its press release, however, Apple also noted that the initial rollout would be limited to iPhones, as support for other platforms was still pending regulatory approval.

Berdasarkan laporan, now, as spotted by reuters, apple intelligence “has been ‌registered for use on tablets and laptops in china, shanghai’s cyberspace regulator said on monday. ”.

For context, generative AI services must complete a regulatory registration process before they can launch publicly in China.

Apple Intelligence, which, in China, relies on Alibaba’s Qwen model to power certain AI features, had already received regulatory approval for iPhones in July, following months of delays and negotiations with Chinese authorities.

Berdasarkan laporan, with today’s registration, apple has cleared another regulatory hurdle ahead of apple intelligence’s launch in china. However, the company has yet to confirm whether iPad and Mac support will also arrive in December.

#510. Apple Won't Make a Small Phone so This Company Is Stepping In

📅 06 Nov 2026

Apple Won't Make a Small Phone so This Company Is Stepping In

Tanggal: 06 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://lifehacker.com/tech/apple-wont-make-a-small-phone-so-this-company-is-stepping-in?utm_medium=RSS

Diungkapkan bahwa big smartphones have long been the norm. Even Apple's smallest iPhone isn't that small, with a 6. (Compare that to the 5. 4-inch iPhone mini it used to sell. It seems many, if not most, of us prefer our smartphones to be akin to tiny tablets. 1-inch display. ) But just because a lot of us like it that way doesn't mean all of us do.

Diungkapkan bahwa despite what companies like apple would lead you to believe, there are plenty of people out there who want their smartphones to be smaller. While the sales might not have been steady enough for Apple to continue producing the mini line, anecdotally, I know quite a few people who would happily keep using iPhones this small, if only Apple would make more of them. For some, the iPhone mini was perfect, featuring a design that most could use comfortably with one hand. Perhaps you know people like this too; maybe you're one of them.

Diungkapkan bahwa while the rumor mill does not suggest that apple plans to make a new iphone mini, that doesn't mean the dream of the tiny smartphone is dead. Enter "Enough Phone," a new device with a humble goal: to create a "small, modern smartphone that's enough. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa enough phone really does seem small. 53 inches, and 0. The company says its upcoming device is 133mm by 64mm, and less than 12mm thick. That's the equivalent of 5. 18 by 2. It's remarkably similar to the iPhone 13 mini, at 5. 52 inches, and less than 0. 47 inches thick. 24 inches by 2. 3 inches thick. While the Enough Phone might be a tad larger overall, and perhaps noticeably thicker, it's still reminiscent of that "mini" footprint.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the enough phone's 5. 3-inch display isn't particularly modern, however. While we don't know the display type, we do know that it has a resolution of 1520 x 720, which may look less sharp to anyone coming from the 2340 x 1080 resolution of the iPhone 13 mini. I'd wager that most people interested in a device like this aren't looking for an ultra-sharp OLED display anyway, but it's worth noting here.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as for the enough phone's other specs, the company says it plans to pack in a 2. 4GHz MediaTek Dimensity 7500 chip with 8GB of RAM, 128GB of built-in storage, though you can expand that with a microSD card (something you don't see on many smartphones these days). The current plan is to ship with a single 50MP Sony IMX766 rear camera, and a 32MP selfie cam, which would be amongst the highest-resolution front-facing cameras on any smartphone. It supports 5G, Wi-Fi 6, and eSIM, with the option to use a physical SIM as well.

Diungkapkan bahwa enough is also aiming to make its smartphone more repairable than the competition. Combined with promised software support through 2032, Enough says this device "should last you into the next decade. While Enough Phone isn't fully modular, it is designed with easy-to-open screws, and comes with a fully replaceable 3,500 mAh battery. While smartphone OEMs have made slight improvements to repairability in recent years, few phones are made to be opened up by the user, and their components replaced. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa now, all of these specs are targets, as the phone is currently in the prototype stage. Enough says that final details may change "slightly" during testing. I would at least hope that the dimensions, particularly the screen size, remain the same by launch. What will likely stay the same, however, are the ringtones: Enough says they hired composer Brian Squillance of LAANDS to produce the jingles for its phone, which is a neat touch.

Diungkapkan bahwa unfortunately for apple fans, however, enough phone isn't an iphone. While you can buy the phone with Android 17 installed, you can also choose to run OdysseyOS, a minimalist "de-Googled" operating system made by SLEKE. That said, it doesn't have to be an Android phone, either. #511. Today’s macOS updates fix security gap involving eMudhra certificates

📅 09 Nov 2026

Today’s macOS updates fix security gap involving eMudhra certificates

Tanggal: 09 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://9to5mac.com/2026/11/09/todays-macos-updates-fix-security-gap-involving-emudhra-certificates/

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, apple today released macos updates that address a security gap involving compromised emudhra certificates, after initially blocking them in safari, mail, and other apps in october. Here are the details.

A few weeks ago, Mozilla reported that private keys of eight intermediate certificate authorities operated by eMudhra, an Indian digital certification company, had been compromised.

In essence, these certificates are used to establish trust in digital certificates that verify website identities and enable secure connections.

With access to the compromised private keys, bad actors could potentially create fraudulent certificates that appear legitimate, allowing them to impersonate websites and intercept sensitive user information.

In response to the compromise, Apple began automatically blocking the affected certificates on October 19, followed by additional protections on October 23.

These changes were delivered through automatic certificate configuration updates, meaning users didn’t need to install a macOS update to be protected.

While these measures protected Safari, Mail, and apps that use Apple’s networking and security frameworks, they didn’t cover all of macOS, as certain command-line tools, including curl and git, could still accept the compromised certificates.

At the time, Apple published a support article with instructions for administrators to manually address this remaining security gap, while promising a fix in a future macOS update.

Today, Apple updated the document to confirm that the fix is now available.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as apple explains, macos 27. 7. 2. 3, and macOS 15. 1, macOS 26. 8. 3, released earlier today, prevent the affected command-line tools from accepting the compromised certificates, eliminating the need for administrators to manually address the issue.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the updates also remove five root ca certificates from /etc/ssl/cert. pem, including three additional eMudhra certificates that weren’t part of Apple’s original manual workaround.

Still, for users who are unable to install the latest macOS updates, Apple continues to provide instructions for manually addressing the issue in its support document, along with the names and SHA-256 fingerprints of the 12 affected certificates and five root CA certificates removed by the updates.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, apple also notes that “some apps and tools include their own list of root ca certificates and don’t use apple’s block or /etc/ssl/cert. pem,” and advises users to contact the developer of those apps and tools.

To read Apple’s full support document, follow this link.

Sebagaimana diketahui, even though the display is more vivid than those on other budget windows laptops, it doesn’t support hdr — which is odd for an oled panel. Speaker quality is decent but rather thin, and the 1080p webcam can be a bit grainy even in well-lit rooms.

Berdasarkan laporan, 1x hdmi, 2x usb-c, 1x 3. 5mm headphone jack.

Sebagaimana diketahui, 1x hdmi, 2x usb-c, 1x 3. 5mm headphone jack.

Don't let the relatively low asking price fool you, as the HP OmniBook 5 is anything but cheap thanks to its eye-catching design, long-lasting battery life, and other excellent features.

Sebagaimana diketahui, like the macbook neo and dell xps 13, the hp omnibook 5 doesn’t look like a typical budget laptop. That's thanks to its thin, elegant all-aluminum design, which looks great and feels good to hold.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the lid flexes a bit when you press in on its center, but the laptop is otherwise very sturdy. 62 x 0. At 12. 46 inches and 2. 3 x 8. 5 pounds, this is a perfect laptop for all-day travel, since you’ll barely feel it in your backpack.

Get instant access to breaking news, the hottest reviews, great deals and helpful tips.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i’m a big fan of the keyboard deck, thanks to its relatively spacious size and thick keycaps that make typing a breeze. The backlit keys are nicely spaced and have excellent travel distance. The touchpad isn’t as large as I’ve seen on other laptops, but it's plenty responsive and never fails to register your gestures.

Diungkapkan bahwa you can technically open the laptop with one hand, though the lid is a bit too sturdy to make that easy. Even though it’s easier to open the laptop with two hands, I appreciate that the lid doesn’t wobble when you’re walking around with the laptop open.

Berdasarkan laporan, port selection is fairly generous for a laptop this thin. 5mm headphone jack. The left side has an HDMI port and two USB-C ports, while the right side has a single 3. The USB-C ports are USB3, whereas the MacBook Neo has one USB3 port and a slower USB2 port. That means you can charge the OmniBook 5 via either USB-C port.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, lastly, the omnibook 5 comes in one of four colors: peony pink, smoke silver, soft honeydew, and starlit blue. Our review unit’s Soft Honeydew (green) color is quite nice and certainly more striking than the silver or black laptops I typically review.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the 14-inch 1920 x 1200 oled panel on the hp omnibook is pretty solid for a laptop in this price range. It delivers decent brightness and oversaturated colors, which helps colors pop. You can see this in the image above, where a video clip of a rabbit basking in the sun appears bright, colorful, and sharp.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, our display benchmark results corroborate my eyes-on experience. The display’s brightness averages 272 nits, which is just shy of the marketed 300 nits. This is as bright as it gets, since the display doesn’t support HDR. Color reproduction numbers for the sRGB and DCI-P3 color gamuts are well above 100%, which accounts for the oversaturated hues.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as you can see above, the displays on the dell xps 13 (2026) and macbook neo can get much brighter with sdr content, not to mention hdr. Color reproduction is also closer to 100%, so colors look more natural. Color accuracy (Delta-E) is also slightly lower (0 is best) on the HP laptop compared to its rivals.

Diungkapkan bahwa the touchscreen is as responsive as you’d expect from a windows 11 machine. It always registered all my taps and swipes accurately. Since the hinge can drop flat, you could theoretically draw on this display more easily. However, since it lacks stylus support, you’d have to draw with your finger, which likely won’t be comfortable or as precise.

Berdasarkan laporan, the hp omnibook 5 has modest specs fitting its price. The $649 starting configuration has an Intel Core 5 315 “Wildcat Lake” chip, 8GB of RAM, 256GB of SSD storage, and lacks a touchscreen. Our $749 review unit is a step up, packing an Intel Core 5 320 CPU, 16GB of RAM, 512GB of storage, and a touch display.

Berdasarkan laporan, this laptop is designed to handle the basics, such as web browsing, working in word processors, and streaming videos. I had no problem using HP’s notebook for my everyday work, which usually involves a dozen open Chrome tabs, light photo editing in GIMP, and the occasional YouTube video running in the background.

Diungkapkan bahwa as you can see above, the hp omnibook 5 fares well against similarly-priced budget laptops. In the Geekbench 6 CPU benchmark, its single- and multi-core scores are fairly close to the Dell XPS 13, which has the same Wildcat Lake processor and amount of memory. However, its SSD speeds (Blackmagic) and Handbrake (video transcoding) scores are noticeably lower.

Berdasarkan laporan, even though the macbook neo we reviewed has only 8gb of ram, it still outperforms both of its wildcat lake-powered rivals by a large margin. The only area where Apple’s affordable MacBook lags is SSD speed. That says a lot about the rock-solid performance the Neo delivers.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, wildcat lake is perfect for basic tasks, but it’s decidedly not built for graphically demanding gaming. In the 3DMark Wildlife Extreme test, which measures a machine’s graphical performance, the HP OmniBook 5 scored 2922 and averaged 18 frames per second.

Diungkapkan bahwa that’s similar to the dell xps 13, though the macbook neo has an edge over both. Using its built-in benchmark tool, Borderlands 3 is unplayable at 10. 5 fps at 1080p. The same is true for the Dell XPS 13 and MacBook Neo.

Even if the Dell XPS 13 and MacBook Neo have better displays and faster performance, HP’s OmniBook 5 smokes both in battery life.

Diungkapkan bahwa in our battery life test, which involves continuous wi-fi web surfing with the display set to 150 nits of brightness, the omnibook 5 ran for an astounding 19 hours and 52 minutes! as you can see below, its competitors don’t even come close. It's impressive that this humble laptop can last as long as a MacBook Pro.

There's a lot to like about the HP OmniBook 5, but its budget nature comes with some compromises.

Sebagaimana diketahui, if the hp omnibook 5 were the only budget laptop like it, i’d likely overlook its lack of hdr support. However, given that the MacBook Neo and Dell XPS 13 do have HDR support, it’s something I can’t entirely ignore. That's why the display doesn’t get nearly as bright as those of its competitors.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in fairness to hp’s laptop, it does sport an oled panel — something the macbook neo and dell xps 13 do not. As a result, this panel offers stronger contrast between dark and light elements than the Neo and XPS’ respective IPS panels. It also delivers bolder colors, which could be a plus for some folks.

Berdasarkan laporan, the hp omnibook 5 has a 1080p fhd ir camera. That’s certainly better than the 720p webcams that budget Windows laptops tend to pack. However, don’t expect the best picture or video quality here.

Berdasarkan laporan, even in my building’s well-lit lobby lounge, the picture i snapped is pretty grainy. Yes, you can still see me and the background clearly enough, but don’t expect to look your best.

Diungkapkan bahwa the hp omnibook 5 is yet another fantastic macbook neo rival for folks looking for a comparable budget windows laptop. The sturdy design and long battery life are highlights, while the impressive OLED panel and strong everyday performance make for an all-around solid laptop that won’t break the bank.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the macbook neo still arguably has an edge thanks to its strong performance, brighter display, and seamless interoperability with apple’s devices. But if you prefer Windows or want astounding battery life, the HP OmniBook 5 is a solid choice.

#519. Five Smartwatch Heart Rate Zone Hacks Every Runner Should Know

📅 06 Nov 2026

Five Smartwatch Heart Rate Zone Hacks Every Runner Should Know

Tanggal: 06 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://lifehacker.com/health/best-smartwatch-heart-rate-zone-training-hacks?utm_medium=RSS

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you've spent any time in or around running culture over the last few years, you've undoubtedly encountered someone preaching the gospel of zone 2 cardio. Legend has it that easy, conversational effort cardio—also known as cardio that takes your heart rate into "Zone 2"—is the secret to unlocking everything from a bigger aerobic engine to faster race times and even a longer life.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, to train by heart rate, you aim to keep your heart rate in the "zone" that gives you the desired workout. The catch is that Zone 2 is easy to get wrong, especially since no one can agree on what it actually means. Your smartwatch can show you your heart rate, but many recreational runners will still drift into a “gray zone” that's too fast to be truly easy, and too slow to give them a real workout. If you're struggling to hit Zone 2 consistently, there are a few smartwatch hacks that can help.

Sebagaimana diketahui, pace can be a distraction during easy runs, especially considering all the different variables that affect your effort, like hills, humidity, and general fatigue. A 9:30 mile might be Zone 2 on a flat, cool day and Zone 4 on a hot, hilly one.

Dig into your watch's activity settings (on Garmin, it's Activity > Data Screens; on Apple Watch, the Workout app's metrics layout; on Coros, Polar, and Suunto, similar menus) and put live heart rate zone front and center, ideally as a zone number or colored gauge rather than just a raw bpm figure (though this assumes these zones are accurate—more on that below).

Berdasarkan laporan, create an alert when your heart rate goes above or below a target range, delivered as a vibration pattern, a beep, or both. Set the alert for the upper boundary of Zone 2, and you've essentially hired a mini coach who taps you on the wrist whenever you get overzealous. Whenever you hear or feel that buzz, you’ll know you need to ease into a slower jog until your heart rate settles.

Diungkapkan bahwa instead of free-running and checking your numbers afterward, build structured workouts that carry the targets for you. In Garmin Connect, TrainingPeaks, Apple's Custom Workout feature, Coros Training Hub, or similar platforms, you can create sessions like "10-minute warm-up in Zone 1, 40 minutes in Zone 2, 5-minute cooldown" and sync them straight to your watch.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, during the run, your watch displays the current step, the target range, and whether you're above, below, or in the pocket. Many will automatically advance between intervals and alert you when it's time to shift gears.

Heart rate-based intervals, like 4 x 4 minutes in Zone 4 with Zone 1 recovery, where you don't have to do mental math or check the clock.

Progressive long runs that start in Zone 2 and finish in Zone 3.

Hill repeats, where pace is meaningless but effort matters.

Berdasarkan laporan, most watches calculate default zones using a generic formula like 220 minus your age, which can be off by 10 to 20 beats for any given individual. If your zones are wrong, your Zone 2 training isn't Zone 2 training.

Here’s how to fix your watch’s heart rate zones:.

Berdasarkan laporan, find your true max heart rate. The informal way is to just notice what number you see on your watch when you can no longer speak comfortably; the more formal way is this treadmill test. You can also look through your recent hard efforts, like races, hill repeats, or all-out intervals, and see the highest sustained heart rate you've recorded.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, use lactate threshold heart rate instead. Many watches can estimate this automatically after a few hard efforts, and zones built from threshold tend to be more personalized than ones built from max.

Sebagaimana diketahui, customize the boundaries. Dive into the heart rate zone settings and input your own numbers. Some runners prefer the "MAF" method (180 minus age, with adjustments) for aerobic base building, and most watches let you set that as a custom range.

Sebagaimana diketahui, recheck every few months. Fitness changes, and so do your zones.

A screen crowded with cadence, vertical oscillation, ground contact time, running power, and lap pace is a recipe for second-guessing.

Sebagaimana diketahui, create a dedicated zone 2 data screen with just two or three fields: current heart rate zone, elapsed time, and maybe distance. Turn off auto-scroll so it doesn't flip to a screen full of numbers you don't need. If your watch supports multiple activity profiles, make a separate "Easy Run" profile with this stripped-down layout and keep a different profile for tempo days and races.

Berdasarkan laporan, a chest strap (or a forearm or upper-arm optical band) is generally more accurate and responsive than the wrist-based sensor on your watch. This COOSPO heart rate monitor is one of my favorites, and it's only $31. For heart rate training, where a few beats can mean the difference between Zone 2 and Zone 3, I recommend buying one. 99.

The bottom line: Your smartwatch can make heart rate training far easier, but only if you set it up to support you rather than overwhelm you.

This is Streamalikes, where you can find a curated list of recommendations to stream based on what you already like.

Following the dramatic conclusion of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners way back in 2022, the show has returned for a new season set in the megalopolis of Night City with a standalone story and a new cast of characters (by necessity).

Diungkapkan bahwa though the aesthetic and themes of cyberpunk have their roots in american science fiction of the 1970s and '80s, anime and manga of the '90s and beyond embraced the form and took it to entirely new places—so much so that a japanese/polish co-production of an adaptation of a video game from a polish designer has taken its cues from a couple of decades' worth of great anime and cerebral sci-fi. Which is to say, if you're looking for more heady sci-fi series, these 10 are a good place to start.

Diungkapkan bahwa an iconic, effortlessly cool genre classic, cowboy bebop is one of the undisputed goats of anime, blending western, noir, and crime genres and setting the resultant mash to a killer soundtrack of old-school jazz (which serves much the same purpose as cyberpunk's propulsive electronic grooves). Different settings, but both shows offer up ragtag crews with highly dubious fates. Former hitman Spike Spiegel leads his crew on one nearly disastrous mission after another, their standalone adventures all building to a thoroughly memorable climax. The title's "cowboys" are bounty hunters in a near-future in which humans have been forced to colonize the solar system after Earth became uninhabitable. Stream Cowboy Bebop on Crunchyroll or buy it from Prime Video.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this one's set in 22nd-century japan, with a slick blade runner-esque aesthetic and a setup reminiscent of minority report. Obviously, this is all perfectly fine, and there’s no potential for abuse or miscalculation whatsoever. The first involves a new Enforcer who becomes a potential murderer himself when he miscalculates the extent of a criminal’s potential to do wrong, and, even more significantly, the existence of a criminal mastermind who is somehow invisible to the tech, even as his criminal actions grow more and more elaborate. Here, technology exists to measure intentions, so crimes can be stopped before they’ve occurred, at which point the “criminals” are placed into psychological treatment (à la A Clockwork Orange)—or subject to summary execution because their threat potential is too high. though there are a couple of warning signs. That ability to predict behavior bleeds over into every aspect of life: careers and even relationships are determined in large part by the same systems that sniff out criminal intent. Stream Psycho-Pass on Prime Video and Crunchyroll.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, created by tim miller and with director david fincher as an executive producer, this animated anthology series is a grab bag of wildly diverse offerings: each episode is produced by a different international studio, with the only link between them being one of the three words in the show's title. Its format dictates that no two episodes are going to have the same premise, but it shares with Cyberpunk an edgy sensibility and stories set in an apocalyptic future, albeit with a dark sense of humor—its four seasons offer up a mix of tech, sex, violence, and gorgeous animation. One episode deals with robotic gladiator fights in dystopian London, another finds us under the threat of sentient yogurt, yet another finds an ambitious cat learning to make use of a family's robot helper. Stream Love, Death & Robots on Netflix.

Sebagaimana diketahui, one of several completely standalone spinoffs of the wildly influential 1995 film (itself based on the beloved manga series), stand alone complex requires no prior knowledge. The style is largely the draw, as the series luxuriates in its fictional Nihama City setting, a world unto itself in a future Japan in which cybernetic people hack directly into the internet. Our sympathies are more with the authorities—in this case, Public Security Section 9, a cybercrime and antiterrorism police unit—than the cyber criminals, but the show approaches some of the same themes as Edgerunners with legit punk style. Stream Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex on Tubi and The Criterion Channel.

Diungkapkan bahwa in this adaptation of the richard k. In this future megacity setting, human consciousness can be transferred between bodies. His motives for bringing the man back are shrouded in mystery, but he's giving Tak a chance to solve a very cold case: his own murder. Kovacs is a former soldier turned mercenary, revived from a backup after 200 years by Laurens Bancroft (James Purefoy), one of the wealthiest men alive. Morgan cyberpunk classic of the same name, Joel Kinnaman and Anthony Mackie (yes, both of them) star as Takeshi "Tak" Kovacs. The tech is widely available, but only the wealthy can afford the backups and protections that make it a form of virtual immortality. Stream Altered Carbon on Netflix.

Diungkapkan bahwa another popular (and emmy-winning) game adaptation, arcane is based on league of legends, a top-down actioner involving online opponents shooting lasers across a map. It doesn't sound like fodder for a show this impressive, but here we are. The painted animation style is truly something special—not a stylistic match for Cyberpunk, but the two shows both go far above and beyond to create striking visual worlds. The League of Legends lore forms the backdrop for the show, but the pull is in the narrative involving two sisters caught up in the growing conflict between a utopian city and its oppressed underclass, without whom it couldn’t exist. Stream Arcane on Netflix.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, vash the stampede is a hunted outcast with a dark history that slowly comes to light over the course of the series. He’s got a reputation as a human wrecking ball, bringing destruction wherever he goes, and seemingly just for fun—but in reality he’s far more respectful of life than his pursuers. He and his friends—actually a couple of insurance agents—find themselves in a series of misadventures on the planet Gunsmoke, building to a final showdown that caps the series with finality. Still, cities evacuate at the mere possibility of his arrival, and a huge bounty sits on his head (no matter that the bounty hunters do far more damage than Vash). Tonally similar, Trigun also shares with Cyberpunk 2 the work of legendary composer Tsuneo Imahori, his music being crucial to both shows. Visually, it’s probably one of the defining ‘90s shōnen-style action series, with elegantly choreographed gunfights that never get old. Stream Trigun on Crunchyroll or buy it from Prime Video.

Diungkapkan bahwa another from animation studio trigger, darling in the franxx leans heavily into the mecha sub-genre, set in a post-apocalypse where children are bred and indoctrinated into piloting the title's massive franxx to defend the remnants of humanity. Adults are pretty much immortal, so the kids simply don't have any other utility. Two of these teens begin to develop romantic feelings for each other, potentially complicating their usefulness to society and leading to an explosive, bittersweet finale. Stream Darling in the Franxx on Crunchyroll or buy it from Prime Video.

Diungkapkan bahwa what starts out as a relatively straightforward action show about space bounty hunters (the title's “killjoys”) develops surprising depth over the course of its five seasons. The show’s creators make exceptionally good use of a limited budget and offer up some impressive queer rep along the way, a rarity in pop sci-fi. As officially sanctioned Killjoys, the trio at the show’s heart (Hannah John-Kamen, Aaron Ashmore, and Luke Macfarlane) are bound to remain politically neutral at any cost. Initially, that’s a way to get them right into the heat of a fight, but as they develop ties of friendship and family in an exploited community, they come to understand the high cost of unchecked wealth and greed, and the ways in which neutrality always benefits the oppressors. Stream Killjoys on Tubi or buy it from Prime Video and Apple TV.

Berdasarkan laporan, another great cyberpunk metropolis: here it's kansai, an increasingly lawless city run by elite criminals known as akudama. An ordinary girl, quite inadvertently, becomes caught up in a major planned heist and is forced to fake credentials as a master swindler in order to stay alive. Like Cyberpunk, the show tackles anti-authoritarian themes among a diverse crew of outsiders. Stream Akudama Drive on Cunrchyroll or buy it from Prime Video.

#524. Report: Apple saved over $5 billion in taxes through Singapore and Ireland in 2026

📅 09 Nov 2026

Report: Apple saved over $5 billion in taxes through Singapore and Ireland in 2026

Tanggal: 09 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://9to5mac.com/2026/11/09/report-apple-saved-over-5-billion-in-taxes-through-singapore-and-ireland-in-2026/

Diungkapkan bahwa a new financial times report reveals how apple saved billions in taxes in 2026 by shifting profits through singapore and ireland. Here are the details.

A few days ago, Apple published its annual Form 10-K, as required by the SEC, containing detailed information about its financial performance and operations for its 2026 fiscal year.

Included in the form, as the FT noted, is information regarding how Apple reduced its tax bill by billions of dollars through its operations in Singapore and Ireland.

Sebagaimana diketahui, for years, apple’s tax arrangements in ireland were the subject of scrutiny, culminating in a 2024 ruling by the eu’s top court that required the company to pay €13 billion in back taxes. Apple completed the payment in 2025.

That came a few years after Apple announced plans to bring most of its $252 billion in overseas cash back to the US, following tax reforms introduced during Donald Trump’s first administration.

Since then, to discourage companies from shifting profits to countries with lower tax rates, more than 130 countries have agreed to introduce a minimum corporate tax rate of 15% for large multinational companies, as part of a 2021 initiative coordinated by the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, under the agreement, companies that pay less than 15% in a particular country may face additional taxes to make up the difference. The new rules also resulted in an additional $2. 5 billion in taxes for Apple in Singapore in 2026, according to the company’s SEC filing.

Ireland adopted the new rules in 2024, followed by Singapore in 2025.

Back to the FT’s report, it notes that new US accounting rules now require publicly traded companies to disclose when their taxes on overseas profits differ significantly from the 21% US federal corporate tax rate.

Berdasarkan laporan, these new requirements revealed that apple saved $2. 7 billion in taxes through Singapore in 2026, surpassing the $2. 6 billion it saved through Ireland.

Berdasarkan laporan, if apple had been taxed on all of its global profits in 2026 at the us federal rate, it would have incurred a total bill of $33bn — demonstrating the scale of the $5bn tax reduction it received from booking profits in ireland and singapore. The company incurred corporation taxes totalling $27bn this year.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the ft also noted that apple’s effective tax rate in singapore fluctuated around 10% between 2023 and 2025, but is expected to approach 15% under the new rules. Singapore’s standard corporate tax rate is 17%.

To read the FT’s original report, follow this link.

Diungkapkan bahwa black friday discounts may not be quite as exciting as they used to be, but it doesn't change the fact that it's the perfect time of year to buy a brand new smartphone. Pulling the trigger at launch often feels like being ripped off, and Black Friday is one of the few times we get to enjoy some serious discounts.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, considering how much phone prices have risen this year, with no sign of stopping, saving some money is more important than ever. But it's not quite as simple as loading up Amazon on November 27 and looking for a new deal. There are plenty of ways to maximize your savings both on Black Friday, and the run up to the day itself.

So, to help you out, here are seven essential tips to save money on your new phone this Black Friday.

Diungkapkan bahwa the most obvious thing to remember is that you shouldn't stick to a specific retailer or carrier to get your phone. If you want to get the best deal you'll need to shop around, and see where your chosen smartphone is on sale and how much everyone is selling it for. Only then can you actually figure out the best place to actually buy it.

But always remember that you should always look at the full scope of the deals, rather than just the listed price or monthly payment.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you prefer to buy a phone through a carrier, and pay off the price over two to four years, then you'll likely gravitate towards the mobile carriers' own stores. But you should always remember to check out MVNOs as well.

Sebagaimana diketahui, mvnos may be virtual operators that piggyback off the infrastructure of the big three, but that doesn't mean they don't sell phones too. In fact some of them have a habit of offering competitive prices to try and pique your interest. Mint Mobile is a good example of this, but there are a bunch of other MVNOs to choose from — some operated by the main carriers, and others than are independent.

Sign up to the Tom's iGuide weekly newsletter with coverage on everything from product launches to software updates, this is your go-to source for the latest updates on all the best Apple content.

Berdasarkan laporan, let's say you want a brand new phone, but there aren't any significant discounts to be had. That's a common occurrence for Apple's iPhones, and the discounts you do get often come from carriers that insist you sign up for an expensive monthly data plan. That is why it's important to check the cost of the associated plans before you buy.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, not all deals rely on expensive plans either. You could find yourself paying close to full price for a new phone, but in the process get access to a cheaper data plan. It's all about doing the math and working out what data and perks you actually need, and whether it makes financial sense to lock into a specific plan for however many years are necessary.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it's well known that trading in your old devices is a great way to save money on a new phone. But not all trade-in offers are created equally, and it literally pays to check the small print and see what the details of the deal actually are.

Berdasarkan laporan, typically trade-ins operate on a system of new phones being worth the most, and the better the condition, the more you get back. But there are instances where those rules don't apply. For example, T-Mobile currently has a deal that offers up to $1,200 off the cost of an iPhone 18 Pro Max with an any condition trade in.

Berdasarkan laporan, this means it doesn't matter how battered your phone may be, if you have one of the eligible devices you will get the full $1,200 credited to your account each month. Though, the newer devices still earn you more credit compared to older ones.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, so you find a deal, and you're wondering whether it's actually a good one. Prices fluctuate all the time, and just because a discount is on offer doesn't necessarily mean a better one isn't around the corner. But how can you tell? You can't predict the future, but you can look back at the price history and see how the current discount compares to what's been offered before.

Sebagaimana diketahui, if you can see that a specific phone was $100 less than the current deal price within the last few months (such as during prime day sales), then there's a good chance that the price might drop a little more as we get closer to black friday itself. Though, I will admit that the multitude of mid-year price hikes does complicate things — because the price you paid in July won't be the same as the price you pay between now and the end of the year.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as for which tools to use, we're big fans of camelcamelcamel, which lets you check the price history of unlocked phones on amazon — with a quick comparison against third party retailers. That gives you an idea of how much a particular phone could cost, when not purchased from a carrier. As for carrier-sold devices, things are a little more complicated, though the deals tend to be focused on trade-ins and data plans rather than the cost of the device itself.

Berdasarkan laporan, just because you see a deal on a phone you like doesn't mean you should buy it right away. If you think the price could drop even further, then you obviously want to wait it out and see what happens. You'll be kicking yourself if you buy a new phone, and two days after it arrives you see it drop even further.

Berdasarkan laporan, but, at the same time, these discounts are always fleeting and temporary. Put off checking out for too long and you could be faced with the prospect of paying full price again. So if you see a deal that you are happy with, there's no harm in confirming your purchase.

Sebagaimana diketahui, brand new phones are always the most expensive, but just because they're available and discounted doesn't mean you have to buy one. As we've seen with Walmart's ongoing Black Friday sale, there are also plenty of discounts on older devices and refurbished models that are looking for a second chance at life. These phones are older, but they're also a lot cheaper than the latest model.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, these deals are, admittedly, not as plentiful because those phones are officially out of production — so there aren't as many devices to go around. Still, the thing you need to remember about modern smartphones is that the differences aren't that major year-on-year. So a Galaxy S25 isn't that much of a step down from the Galaxy S26, and thanks to Samsung's commitment to 7 years of software support, a year-old phone isn't going to be a security risk for some time.

#528. ChatGPT's New GIF Generator Is Fun, but Won't Replace Us Humans (Yet)

📅 06 Nov 2026

ChatGPT's New GIF Generator Is Fun, but Won't Replace Us Humans (Yet)

Tanggal: 06 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://lifehacker.com/tech/chatgpts-new-gif-generator-is-fun-but-wont-replace-us-humans?utm_medium=RSS

Diungkapkan bahwa khamosh pathak is a freelance tech journalist with over 13 years of experience writing online. An accounting graduate, he turned his interest in writing and technology into a career. He holds a specialization in user experience design from ISDI Parsons in Mumbai, where he sought to deepen his understanding of UX, consumer devices, and interplay between software and technology.

Berdasarkan laporan, khamosh has written thousands of how-tos and guides on every major platform (ios, macos, android, and windows). His work has also been seen at MakeUseOf, How-To Geek, and PCMag. He got started writing how-tos and guides for Guiding Tech, where he also published several e-books. He is truly passionate about brewing good coffee.

Diungkapkan bahwa when it comes to generating ai images, both gemini and chatgpt do a passable job. In most cases, the results will look AI-generated, but they likely won’t have glaring spelling issues or missing limbs. Now, OpenAI is trying something new, introducing GIF support for ChatGPT. It's the company's first "moving images" feature since OpenAI shut down Sora, and while you can generate hyper-realistic videos in Gemini, this new ChatGPT feature is trying to fill in the gap, in a small way.

Sebagaimana diketahui, openai is pitching the new feature as an animation tool, not exactly as a way to create looping videos—though that’s how i ended up using it. ChatGPT uses sketches as the base for animations, though it can turn any still image into animated GIFs. You give ChatGPT a prompt, as detailed as you can make it, and the chatbot produces a GIF in just a few seconds. You can start with your own drawings or images, too. Like other AI editing tools, you can edit it if ChatGPT didn't quite get it right: You can ask ChatGPT to make the GIF longer or shorter, remove certain objects, change the style, slow down transitions, among other edits.

Diungkapkan bahwa ai art can be quite sterile, but i was surprised by how adding motion and animation to the mix makes generating images a lot more fun. In my testing, I found this to be the most rewarding part. It’s not always possible to one-shot a GIF with a single prompt. Unlike traditional GIFs, which usually pull from existing video clips, you can turn anything you want into a GIF, which is especially cool if you're using your own art. But after a few rounds of edits, I ended up creating some GIFs that I actually wanted to share in my WhatsApp groups.

Berdasarkan laporan, that being said, i think human-made gifs are still the gold standard here. It did okay, but it’s nothing like actually making a pour-over. For example, I asked ChatGPT to generate a video of someone brewing a pour-over, with a gooseneck kettle, showing the coffee blooming process. The kettle doesn’t move in circles, the water doesn’t rise evenly, there are no bubbles, and the steam is all over the place.

Sebagaimana diketahui, compare that to the gif below, which comes from a royalty-free video. The details captured by a real video just aren’t there in ChatGPT GIFs. Even though it’s a compressed, low-quality, and noisy GIF, it still shows the movement of the pour, the water rising, and even the bubbles. If that’s what you’re expecting, you will be disappointed. But I don't think that's the point of this feature anyway.

Berdasarkan laporan, i found that chatgpt excels when you’re making something fun, and you don’t look into the details too much. I asked it to create a fun promotional GIF for my JBL Bluetooth speakers, and it did the job quite well. At first, the transitions were too jarring, and the movement just made no sense. It even made a GIF based on a photo. It pulled off a loop of a cat playing with a ball, and it was great at making a festive GIF for Diwali. After some editing, though, I got it to a decent place.

Berdasarkan laporan, still, the main issue with chatgpt gifs is that complex movement and transitions aren’t nailed down. A hand shifts position weirdly between frames, and colors and objects appear out of nowhere. But if you can get over these issues, you can make some fun, lighthearted GIFs and memes to share with your friends on Instagram or WhatsApp.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, should you upgrade to the new ceramic apple watch 12? it’s been quite a while since apple offered its flagship wearable in a material other than metal. The last ceramic Apple Watch model was 2019’s Series 5.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, long a fan of the ceramic case, i was thrilled to see apple bring it back for 2026. That excitement only increased after my colleague Jane got her hands on the Series 12 Ceramic at Apple HQ and confirmed its immense beauty.

But is the Apple Watch 12 Ceramic right for you? I can think of three major reasons that justify the upgrade, along with two drawbacks worth considering.

Berdasarkan laporan, the apple watch series 12 comes in ceramic for the first time since 2019. Compared to Apple's metal case options, ceramic is more durable, with a smooth, pearl-like finish. Choose from Midnight Blue or Pearl White.

Berdasarkan laporan, beauty is in the eyes — on the wrist — of the beholder. Let’s be real, though: The primary reason most folks are considering the Apple Watch 12 in a ceramic case is because of its premium and unique look and feel.

The Series 12 is offered in both Pearl White and Night Blue ceramic options; I’m particularly partial to the former, which apparently looks a bit more cream than white IRL with a lovely pearl-like finish.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the night blue option, meanwhile, is more of a muted, metallic blue, giving it a less ceramic-like look than the white one. It’s also overall a bit more subtle on the wrist, i. e. , less likely to lead to folks "ooing" and "aahing" at parties.

Apple’s ceramic cases are also smoother to the touch than the metal options, adding to the premium vibes.

Get instant access to breaking news, the hottest reviews, great deals and helpful tips.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in addition to a more premium look and feel, the ceramic apple watch 12 models are also more durable than their metal counterparts. Apple’s ceramic case combines zirconium dioxide and aluminum oxide, which results in exceptional hardness/scratch resistance, fade resistance, and structural strength.

Ceramic is also more skin-friendly than aluminum or titanium, something worth considering if you have sensitive skin.

Sebagaimana diketahui, for the standard apple watch 12 aluminum models, users can choose between a more affordable gps-only watch or a slightly pricier gps+cellular model. The Series 12 Ceramic, on the other hand, only comes with both GPS and cellular, saving you the decision.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, better yet, unlike aluminum or titanium, ceramic doesn’t tend to block cellular and wifi signals. Now, Apple won’t tell you the connectivity of the ceramic models is superior to that of the metal ones thanks to this higher degree of radio transparency, but I suspect it is.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the primary reason to skip the ceramic apple watch series 12 is the cost. The standard aluminum Series 12 starts at $399 for the 42mm GPS option. The titanium Series 12 starts at $699, while the ceramic Series 12 will set you back either a cool $899 for the 42mm or a piggy-bank-smashing $949 for the 46mm.

Those prices make the Ceramic Series 12 even more expensive than the Apple Watch Ultra 4.

Diungkapkan bahwa the other reason to consider skipping the apple watch 12 in ceramic is its comparably larger size and weight versus the aluminum and titanium models. For example, the 46mm Midnight Blue option weighs 52. 9 g compared to 38. 6 g for the aluminum 46mm.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the ceramic model is also 1 mm taller and 1 mm wider than the aluminum models, making the bezel appear slightly chunkier. Finally, the Series 12 Ceramic is 0. 15 mm thicker, though I’m not certain you’ll notice that increase.

What are your thoughts on the new Apple Watch Series 12 in ceramic? Are you pleased to see the case option return? Have you owned a ceramic Apple Watch before? Are you considering the upgrade? Let me know your thoughts below.
