#606. Why I'd Choose the Oura Ring 5 Over the Cheaper Ultrahuman Pro

📅 03 Nov 2026

Why I'd Choose the Oura Ring 5 Over the Cheaper Ultrahuman Pro

Tanggal: 03 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://lifehacker.com/health/oura-ring-5-vs-ultrahuman-ring-pro?utm_medium=RSS

Berdasarkan laporan, ultrahuman’s ring pro is now officially on sale in the u. , which makes this the perfect time to consider how this new device compares to the reigning champ in the smart ring market, the Oura Ring 5. S. Here's the short answer: While there’s a lot to like in the Ultrahuman Ring Pro, ultimately I think the Oura Ring 5 is just better at doing its job.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i’ve spent plenty of time with both rings, and admittedly, many of the differences between the two will come down to personal preference—for example, do you like the biohacking concept and the “next best actions” suggestions in the ultrahuman app, or do you favor the soothing vibes of the oura app? but when it comes to the devices themselves, there are big differences between them in terms of size, cost, and overall ease of use. Here’s my take on each, and why Oura is still my top choice.

Berdasarkan laporan, the oura ring 5 is impressively small, and when you have to wear something on your finger, size matters a lot—and generally, smaller is better. The Oura Ring 5 is the smallest and most comfortable smart ring I’ve ever worn. I have a ton of photos here comparing it in size to other smart rings (including RingConn, older Oura rings, and an older Ultrahuman); suffice it to say, the Oura Ring 5 wins this category easily.

Diungkapkan bahwa when it comes to the interior fit, both rings are similar: mostly smooth on the inside, without any intrusive bumps. But considering the overall shape and feel, the Oura Ring 5 is just more comfortable to wear throughout an entire day.

Diungkapkan bahwa the oura ring 5 comes with a plug-in charger, which isn’t very convenient, but will get the job done. You can buy a slim, rounded charging case that easily fits in your pocket for $99. You need to match the size of the case to the size of your ring, and the charging case is not compatible with earlier versions of the device. It’s good for 30 days of charge, according to Oura.

Diungkapkan bahwa the ultrahuman ring pro comes with a charging case that is heavy and bulky with prominent corners, but good for an extra 45 days of battery life. The case fits any size of Ultrahuman Ring Pro, but is not compatible with previous versions. You can have the case play sounds if you’ve misplaced it.

Berdasarkan laporan, the ultrahuman ring lasts slightly longer on a charge: up to 15 days, according to the company, versus six to nine for the oura ring 5. The Ultrahuman ring also has several different battery modes, with “chill mode” lasting me about two weeks when I tested it. The company says some users are finding the latest software update extends battery a bit further.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, to sum up: the ultrahuman ring lasts longer on a charge and has more capacity in its charging case. You also get the charging case for free. But the Oura Ring 5’s charging case is smaller and much easier to carry around. Once again, we’re looking at two decent options: The Oura case is more expensive for what you get, but it’s also nicer to use.

Berdasarkan laporan, oura is the most expensive smart ring out there, and it requires a subscription. That makes it the priciest option, giving Ultrahuman an opening to beat it simply by virtue of being cheaper. If you’re looking for the cheapest possible smart ring, well, you’d probably end up with something else entirely, like a RingConn Air. but only if you’re saying no to all the extras. But this one is closer to a wash, depending on the choices you make. But between the Oura Ring 5 and the Ultrahuman Ring Pro, the latter is cheaper than the Oura Ring 5. Let me break it down.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the oura ring 5 costs $399 for the shiny black and silver models, and $499 for gold, rose, and the matte versions of the black and silver. 99/month (or $69. The subscription costs $5. 99/year, which is only a $2 savings), and the Oura is basically useless without the subscription.

Here's how the cost works out on an annual basis:.

Sebagaimana diketahui, oura ring 5 in black or silver: $399 + $5. 88 for one year, $542. 99/month subscription = $470. 76 for two years.

Diungkapkan bahwa oura ring 5 in other colors: $499 + $5. 99/month subscription = $570. 88 for one year, $642. 76 for two years.

Berdasarkan laporan, the ultrahuman ring pro is $479 for all colors, and there is no subscription for basic use of the ring. Some are totally free, including the caffeine window,  smart alarms, a new parent mode, and a limited version of the cycle and ovulation tracker, but others carry a monthly fee. But you can't necessarily stop there, because the Ultrahuman app includes “PowerPlugs” that will give you extra features or analysis screens. And if you consider all the optional subscription fees for different PowerPlugs, they can quickly add up:.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, healthex, to connect medical records: $4. 99/month.

Sebagaimana diketahui, most people probably wouldn't choose all of them, but even if you just wanted, say, respiratory health and cycle & ovulation pro, you’d quickly outstrip the price of an oura ring’s subscription. 99/month or $99. That's cheaper than subscribing to all of the options individually, but it will also make the Ultrahuman Ring Pro more expensive than the Oura Ring 5: $578. On the other hand, Ultrahuman also offers an Ultrahuman Max plan for $9. 98 for two years. 99 total for one year, or $678. 99/month. 99/year that includes all the PowerPlugs mentioned above, plus the Les Mills workouts that normally run $11. In short, if you want everything that each ring has to offer, the Ultrahuman will cost you more.

Diungkapkan bahwa here's the big caveat: i wouldn't recommend bothering with most of the powerplugs. For example, "UltraSync for Tesla" recommends settings for your car based on how rested you are, which will be useless if you don't have a Tesla, and probably even if you do. "Cardio adaptability" measures a metric that Ultrahuman says is subtly different from HRV; Oura doesn't measure this adaptability metric, but it's not clear to me whether it's even worth measuring at all (I'd argue probably not).

Berdasarkan laporan, ultrahuman's respiratory health powerplug ($3. 99/month) records sounds while you sleep, which Oura doesn't do; but Oura reports breathing disturbances based on the ring's data, which Ultrahuman doesn't do. Ultrahuman's feature is more expensive.

Berdasarkan laporan, ultrahuman offers a premium version of its cycle tracker for $3. 99/month, while Oura has a partnership with Natural Cycles that cost $149. 99/year. Either will provide more detailed (and, each company says, more accurate) cycle tracking than the basic tracking each app provides without the extras. Oura's option is more expensive.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, ultrahuman's healthex powerplug ($4. 99/month) displays information from your medical records throughout the app; Oura lets you import your medical records for free, but uses them mainly in the Advisor (chatbot) and dedicated areas of the app. Ultrahuman's option is more expensive.

Sebagaimana diketahui, oura's app gives you scores for your readiness, sleep, and recent activity, and it tracks how stressed you seem to be throughout the day. A message at the top of the main screen gives you advice for what to do that day—for example, scaling back your workouts if you seem to be tired or stressed. Ultrahuman does pretty much the same thing, giving you a "next best action" that changes throughout the day, but tends to stick to predictable themes: get more activity if you've been sitting, and that sort of thing.

Berdasarkan laporan, both give detailed breakdowns of the factors that contribute to your scores, and both likely overstate how useful their scores are (you don't actually need to change your workout plans just because you had a less-than-perfect night of sleep). But the apps handle the basics pretty similarly: Both have partners and integrations, and you can book blood tests through either app, if you want to do that for some reason.

Berdasarkan laporan, ultrahuman gives you a bit more guidance on circadian rhythms, urging you to get in extra steps during certain times of day, and offering to micromanage your caffeine intake. It has a "longevity" tab that puts your long-term habits in terms of how many years they are supposedly subtracting from (or adding to) your lifespan, including measurable metrics like VO2max and a few things that are more inscrutable, like arterial stiffness.

Berdasarkan laporan, oura has a whole tab of "vitals" that it calculates from your day-to-day data, which i find more useful than ultrahuman's data views. The items here include "resilience," which compares your stress to your recovery; a "symptom radar" that can sometimes flag when you're sick; and metrics of sleep regularity and how you're breathing. And, of course, you can check your "cardiovascular age" to see how much younger (or older) you should feel.

Berdasarkan laporan, overall, i prefer oura's approach because the metrics make more sense, are easier to find, and are less likely to feel like they're going way out on a limb relative to the underlying science. Ultrahuman wants you to feel like a cutting-edge biohacker; Oura does a bit more to keep things down to earth. It is a bit funny to remember that both apps, and their wealth of data, are basically just pulling from heart rate readings throughout the day and night. Neither app gives you any truly important information the other doesn't, but Oura's makes more sense to me.

#611. The Out of Touch Adults' Guide to Kid Culture: What Does 'Code Rot' Mean?

📅 03 Nov 2026

The Out of Touch Adults' Guide to Kid Culture: What Does 'Code Rot' Mean?

Tanggal: 03 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://lifehacker.com/entertainment/the-out-of-touch-adults-guide-to-kid-culture-code-rot?utm_medium=RSS

A weekly deep dive into the current trends, slang, and viral videos of youth culture in terms that even the squarest can understand.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this week's out-of-touch guide takes a look at a phenomena that's probably going to define the lives of generations of young people: code rot—both actual computer-style code rot, and the more elusive cultural kind. I'm also taking a look at the fake controversy over the "cancellation" of Freddy Krueger, and finally, bringing things home with viral videos of boyfriends dancing.

Diungkapkan bahwa expect to hear young people talking about code rot for awhile, maybe for the rest of their lives. Code rot, or software rot, describes what happens to a computer program when the hardware and operating system it runs on advance. It's a concept that's going to affect them more than any previous generation. If older programs aren't updated, they become less stable and glitchy until they eventually become unusable.

Diungkapkan bahwa the idea of code rot has really caught on in the young people's popular imagination, probably because they're going to spend a lot of their lives dealing with it. They've even taken the idea of code rot into life, and use the phrase to describe anything that is worn out or malfunctioning. If the ice cream machine isn't working at McDonald's, it's code rotted. Bad grades on a report card? Code rot.

Kids are making videos where they demonstrate actual code rot:.

or point out physical things that are code rotted, like a cat:.

Diungkapkan bahwa interestingly, a lot of the online discourse around code rotting concerns the massive video game platform roblox. Because Roblox games there are made by users, there's often not a lot of incentive for the creators to keep the games current with the platform's changes, so a lot of Gen Z's childhood memories of playing games are sinking into code rot. Here's a video about it:.

Sebagaimana diketahui, another interesting wrinkle is the tone these videos take. While it's mostly hyperbole, I think part of it is the realization that the entire world is code rotted. Code rot is seen as apocalyptic. The old programs that used to run within the "Western Culture" operating system no longer apply and everything is starting to glitch out.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the meaning of "pdf file" depends on the context. If you're at work, it refers to a Portable Document Format file, a format created by Adobe that is famously hard for older people to open. In slang, though, PDF file is algo speak for "pedophile. " Because that word is flagged by moderation software online, people say "PDF File" to skirt the censorship.

Diungkapkan bahwa the run-up to halloween brought a lot of online discourse about nightmare on elm street villain freddy krueger. It's a good point, but not a call for "cancellation. The supernatural serial murder/PDF File was supposedly cancelled online by overly woke, Gen-Z Tiktokers outraged that he is a child predator. The controversy started with a post from Entertainment Industry Reporter that points out how strange it is that in the '80s and '90s, Freddy Krueger, depicted in 1984's A Nightmare on Elm Street as a child murderer so driven by bloodlust he transcended death, was featured on dolls, board games, and lunchboxes aimed at children. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa although the article does say that "freddy krueger lunchboxes shouldn’t exist," and that parents "shouldn’t have been buying their kids action figures of a child murderer," this is not a call to action. It's not suggesting cancellation of any kind, and it's hard to even conceive of what cancellation of a fictional character in an old horror franchise would even mean. The article is actually an observation about how merchandising (and low-quality sequels) change the meaning of art. But people online missed the point entirely and invented a scenario where "woke" young people are calling for the cancellations of a fictional villain for doing bad things.

I've been scouring TikTok, looking for even one video where someone is calling for "canceling" Freddy Krueger, and I can't find any, but there are hundreds, maybe thousands of videos like this:.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in these videos, people point out how enraging it is that the woke people are calling for krueger's cancellation and vowing that they won't let it happen. Supposedly, younger users were unaware that Krueger is depicted as a "PDF file" as well as a murderer in the 2010 reboot of the franchise, so there are online arguments about whether that's the reason he's being canceled. Even though it is not happening. Meanwhile, the real villain is a lack of media literacy. These anti-woke folks are, ironically, defending a fictional villain from cancellation by creating another fictional villain, the shadowy woke mob that's ruining horror movies. Even though no one is canceling anything. There are even levels to the myths about woke mobs canceling Freddy. Saying "wow, it's crazy that previous generations made a comedy mascot of such a terrible character and marketed him to children" is not the same as cancellation.

Diungkapkan bahwa this week's viral videos are of boyfriends dancing. The newest thing on the TikTok is young women sharing video of their boyfriends getting down accompanied by a clip from the song "gay alligations fr. my girlfriend" by TikToker OH MICKEY. Like this:.

Diungkapkan bahwa it's a simple, silly template that maybe doesn't mean a whole lot, but this generation of young men are so messed up when it comes to relationships and masculinity, i'm always happy when a meme becomes popular that indicates that young women want goofy dudes, dudes who know how to dance, and dudes who act silly as boyfriends more than they want red-pilled, manosphere, looksmaxxing types. I don't know if these kinds of messages ever really "break through" to the underground of internet incels, but I like to hope they do, because a lot of young men are not OK.

Otherwise, there's little to complain about when it comes to performance, with PCMag reporting that apps respond almost instantly and 4K streams load quickly with almost no blurry, low-resolution moments.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the redesigned alexa voice remote is another improvement, with a more comfortable shape, an easier-to-find home button, and dedicated shortcuts for major streaming services. #614. Six Fitness 'Rules' That Don't Actually Matter

📅 03 Nov 2026

Six Fitness 'Rules' That Don't Actually Matter

Tanggal: 03 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://lifehacker.com/fitness-rules-that-are-okay-to-break?utm_medium=RSS

Diungkapkan bahwa i’ve learned a lot in my many years in the gym, and beginner-me would be shocked and appalled by the things present-me does during workouts. With the benefit of experience, I now do exercises I used to think one should “never” do, and I’ve broken pretty much every other rule besides.

I've already explained a bunch of things you can stop worrying about as a beginner, but I’d like to expand on that list with a few more rules that even intermediate-level exercisers can ditch without consequence.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you can theoretically do 13 bicep curls with a certain weight, how many curls should you actually do? one common misconception is that if you don’t do all 13, you’re leaving gains on the table. The rule kind of makes sense if you have truly no clue where to start; if you go until you can’t do a single rep more, then at least you know you’re not slacking off.

Berdasarkan laporan, but the downside is that going to failure for every set of every lift is just going to make you exhausted. On bicep curls, maybe not so much, but once you’re squatting pretty heavy weights, you’re going to feel spent if you do every single set to failure, and that fatigue will get in the way of getting a good workout in consistently. What’s better is to follow a program that advises you on when to hold back and when it’s a good time to really push your limits. You’ll find that most of the time, you stop a set at least 2-3 reps shy of failure, and sometimes even more.

Diungkapkan bahwa rest days are a convenient tool for making sure you’re not overworking yourself, but that’s all. Once you’re talking about athletes or enthusiasts, the ACSM acknowledges that training most days of the week is fine if your program manages fatigue effectively. Organizations like the American College of Sports Medicine recommend leaving 48 hours between intense strength-training sessions for a given muscle, but if you look at where they get that number, it’s meant to be a general recommendation for beginners and for people who are exercising just to stay healthy. That may mean alternating between heavier and lighter days, rather than taking complete rest days.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the “10% rule” is a not-terrible guideline for figuring out how quickly to ramp up your training. But like many of these other myths, it’s a suggestion, not a commandment to be strictly obeyed.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as running coach jason fitzgerald told lifehacker, “while the adage is to only increase weekly mileage by 10%, this may be either too conservative or even too aggressive depending on where you start from. ” When you’re coming back from a short layoff, you can probably increase mileage a lot faster. Same goes if you’re a beginner and your mileage is overall very low; if you took the rule literally, you wouldn’t be able to increase from zero to any other number.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, meanwhile, serious running programs—once again, a program is a wonderful thing—may give you a bigger increase for a few weeks in a row, then cut back and decrease your mileage temporarily before ramping up again. Or they may keep you at the same mileage for weeks at a time before venturing a larger increase. If you were to stick to the 10% rule, you would miss out on the advantages of programs that work this way.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, there are pros and cons to lifting before cardio, and to doing cardio before lifting. It’s more of an “it depends” than a rule. So here are some of the ways to decide which makes sense.

Your lifts tend to suffer when you’re fatigued, and doing them fresh is important to you.

Cardio is your top priority, and you want to have more energy for it.

Your lifts are the kind of thing that can get done even when you’re fatigued.

Or you only intend to do a small amount of cardio before lifting.

Sebagaimana diketahui, so a cyclist may prefer to do a strength workout after hopping off the bike, but a powerlifter would probably rather get their conditioning in after finishing squats for the day. Either is fine if you don’t care, or if you prefer to mix it up.

Berdasarkan laporan, there are a few supplements that can help you in your fitness journey, but none of them are necessary. It’s understood to be effective, but here’s the thing: Just because it does something for most people doesn’t mean it does very much. Creatine is one of the best-known muscle-building supplements. If you decide it’s too expensive or just that you would rather not have another thing to remember to take every day, you’re not missing out on any substantial amount of gains.

Likewise, protein powder is a helpful way to get more protein in your diet, but you don’t need to use a supplement; you can just eat more protein-containing foods.

Sebagaimana diketahui, and finally, pre-workout drinks can give you more energy in the gym (it’s mostly caffeine), but the idea that you need it is a very recent development. Even ten years ago, it wasn’t really a thing. People showed up to the gym with a coffee or a coke or with no caffeine at all in their stomach, and worked out just fine.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, look, people have been exercising successfully for millennia, but all of our apps and devices weren't even a thing until the 2000s. Tracking every minute, every step, or every mile of your routine is not actually necessary. You don’t even have to track your sets and reps in your lifting journal if you don’t want to. You’re still a runner even if you don’t have an app that knows how many miles you ran. Your body is what knows how much work you put in, even if your phone were to get wiped overnight.

#616. All the Health and Fitness Products You Didn't Realize You Could Buy With HSA Funds

📅 02 Nov 2026

All the Health and Fitness Products You Didn't Realize You Could Buy With HSA Funds

Tanggal: 02 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://lifehacker.com/health/health-and-fitness-products-hsa-fsa-funds?utm_medium=RSS

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you have a flexible spending account (fsa), it's that time of year: use those funds, or you'll lose them. Luckily, there are plenty of clever ways to spend your remaining FSA funds on qualifying healthcare costs—some that you may never have considered as "qualifying. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, for instance, you can use your fsa or hsa funds to get yourself a sweet new fitness tracker or smartwatch (even the latest fitbit air). At least, that's what plenty of brands like Whoop, Oura, and even Nike want you to think. Is the process really as straightforward as the marketing suggests? Here's what to know about all the unexpected ways you can spend your FSA funds before the end of the year.

Right off the bat, when it comes to most of these fitness trackers and smartwatches, your HSA/FSA dollars won't be able to cover the entire purchase; instead, you'll save an average of 30% on eligible health purchases.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, there is some more fine print, although it’s not as tricky as you might think. For the most part, if a device is necessary for treating or monitoring a specific medical condition—and not just “general wellness”—it could be eligible to purchase with those pre-tax health dollars.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the main “catch” here (as i’ve previously explained) is proving that device is in fact necessary, which requires you to obtain a letter of medical necessity (lmn). Your LMN is basically a doctor's note required to classify certain purchases as qualified medical expenses under IRS guidelines, proving that the device will be used to treat a legitimate medical condition, such as obesity or a heart condition. Let’s take a look at what you can actually expect if you want to get a fitness wearable approved as a medical necessity.

Diungkapkan bahwa when it comes to securing your lmn, you might not even need to make a doctor's appointment, thanks to third-party players like truemed. From there, you'll be asked a few questions about your health circumstances, and you’ll be matched with a provider to determine your eligibility. When you browse sites like Coros, Amazfit, and more, you'll see the option to “Pay With Truemed” at checkout. If you qualify, you’ll get an LMN that will allow you to use your HSA or FSA funds to complete your purchase—all without ever having to meet with your primary doctor.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, truemed is one of the most popular payment platforms in this space, with the company claiming on its site that “90% of lmns are issued within seven hours. Because Truemed screens your case before it has a chance of getting denied, those approval numbers get to stay mighty high. If it doesn't, Truemed won't bother forwarding the request at all. After you take that short survey about your health, an independent licensed provider reviews your answers before deciding whether the purchase looks medically necessary. ” I spoke with Truemed’s co-founder and CEO Justin Mares to find out how it works behind the scenes. And the reality is, most Americans will have at least one health marker—like weight or cholesterol levels—that they can self-report to prove that, say, a Fitbit Air is necessary tool for prevention and maintenance.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, for the purchases that do go through to a medical professional, approval turns out to be surprisingly straightforward. They simply take you at your word and help you manage the risk. “If you go into a doctor's office and say your family has a history of high blood pressure,” Mares says, “your doctor probably is not going to ask for lab work before they'll talk to you about it. ” Proving HSA/FSA eligibility works on that same standard fairly often, according to Mares. It comes down to the idea of "standard of care" in general. You're not submitting a stack of medical records; you're answering a simple intake form about your health history, and a licensed clinician uses that, plus their own judgment, to decide whether a given product is appropriate for you.

Diungkapkan bahwa before you get your hopes up too high, fsa/hsa eligibility for wearables is still far from a free-for-all. An LMN only covers you, personally, for a specific product from a specific merchant, and it's usually tied to a specific condition, like cardiovascular risk, pre-diabetes, sleep issues, chronic pain, and so on. Some employers' FSA administrators scrutinize wearable purchases more closely than others, and even a fully compliant LMN doesn't guarantee your plan will approve the claim. Some companies (like Coros, for one) are more transparent about walking customers through the required medical consultation at checkout, while other brands market "HSA/FSA eligible" prominently without explaining that the LMN step is what actually makes that true. Luckily, I’ve saved you some time and rounded up some of the major wearables—and other unexpected items—that you might be able to prove as FSA/HSA eligible.

Diungkapkan bahwa screenless recovery trackers like whoop, amazfit helio strap, and the oura ring can usually be justified as hsa/fsa eligible around sleep quality, hrv-based stress monitoring, or recovery tracking tied to a chronic condition. These tend to draw more scrutiny from plan administrators simply because they're marketed as lifestyle products first, so the strength of your intake answers matters more here than it does for something obviously medical, like a blood pressure cuff.

Berdasarkan laporan, if cardiovascular monitoring, training load tracking, or heart rate accuracy is relevant to a documented health concern, these watches can qualify the same way a basic tracker does. Amazfit similarly lets you filter by HSA/FSA eligibility for its smartwatches. Sadly, no Garmin watches are HSA/FSA-eligible. For instance, Coros offers FSA/HSA eligibility for all its watches and heart rate monitors through its partnership with Truemed. Still, the following Garmin-brand products are eligible for an HSA/FSA purchase:.

You can filter by HSA/FSA eligibility and browse all eligible Garmin items here.

Diungkapkan bahwa think adjustable dumbbells, rowing machines, and connected bikes. It's the same logic doctors use when they tell a patient with pre-diabetes or high cholesterol to start exercising regularly; if a clinician is willing to attest that structured exercise is part of your treatment plan, equipment that enables that can qualify. For instance, here are some HSA/FSA eligible products from Nike Strength:.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the common thread across all of these is that the product itself doesn't determine eligibility—your health history does. If you're curious whether something on your wish list might qualify, it's worth filling out the intake process just to see how creatively you can spend those pre-tax health dollars. A Whoop band might be an easy approval for someone managing a cardiac condition, but it'll get more pushback for someone with no relevant health history at all. However you choose to spend your FSA funds, don’t let that money go to waste.

We're highlighting the small changes—from useful new gadgets, to fresh productivity techniques, to efficient hacks—that are improving our lives on a weekly basis.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i may not be “messy,” exactly, but no one would describe me as “neat,” either. One of my biggest issues is that I tend to wait for a mess to get big enough to justify dragging out a full-size vacuum before I deal with it, because a full-size vacuum means finding the cord or the charger, wrestling it out of the closet, going room to room, and then putting it all away again. When the mess in question is still only a few cracker crumbs? Forget it—I'm just too lazy.

The solution to my laziness has been removing all the friction and hassle of my full-size vacuum, and instead keeping a handheld vacuum always within reach.

Diungkapkan bahwa though there are many handheld vacuums out there, i use the sharper image dual air slim, which i got from target. It's great for quickly sucking up crumbs and everyday messes, and that's exactly the job I need it to handle. The "dual air" part is what makes it more interesting than your average handheld: It's both a vacuum and a blower, so it can pull debris in or push it out, depending on what you're dealing with. I didn’t expect to need the blower at all, but I’m surprised how handy it is for blasting crumbs out of keyboard keys or loosening up stubborn debris before I suck it up.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the result is that my apartment is simply cleaner. Not because I'm spending more time cleaning overall, but because I'm no longer letting small messes pile up into big ones. When my monthly (or quarterly) deep clean does roll around, it's far less painful, because there's so much less to deal with. Perhaps this is the real upgrade: cleaning up messes the moment they happen instead of saving them up.

Diungkapkan bahwa i love the sharper image dual air slim, but there are plenty of similar cordless handheld vacuum and air duster combos out there, and they tend to land in a pretty similar price range. If another one catches your eye, or goes on sale, or has a design you prefer, go for it.

When comparing models, here are my handheld vacuum musts:.

It should offer both vacuum and blower modes.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it should be both cordless and rechargeable. If it needs an outlet, you'll have another barrier to using it, and that defeats the purpose.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it should be lightweight and slim. You want something you can grab and use one-handed without thinking about it.

Diungkapkan bahwa the dust cup should be easy to empty. If emptying it is a hassle, you'll use it less.

Berdasarkan laporan, you should be able to keep it in plain sight. The closer it lives to where messes happen (the kitchen, the entryway), the more you'll use it.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i used to think a clean apartment meant big, scheduled cleaning sessions. Now I think it's mostly about making the small stuff effortless. A handheld vacuum and blower won't replace your regular vacuum, but it will make you far less likely to need it as often. If you've been waiting for the next big mess, or the next big clean, to get things tidy, consider changing the system instead.

📅 30 Oct 2026

If You Loved 'VisionQuest,' There's One Movie You Need to Watch Next

Tanggal: 30 Oct 2026 | Sumber: https://lifehacker.com/entertainment/best-movie-for-fans-of-visionquest?utm_medium=RSS

Jeff Somers is a freelancer who has been writing about writing, books, personal finance, and home maintenance since 2012.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, jeff has published nine novels and more than 70 short stories; his story ringing the changes was selected for inclusion in the best american mystery stories 2006. In 2018, Jeff published the book Writing Without Rules: How to Write & Sell a Novel Without Guidelines, Experts, or (Occasionally) Pants. He holds a bachelor’s degree in English and previously worked in medical publishing as a production editor.

Berdasarkan laporan, when not writing, jeff spends his free time fixing up his old house. He has tackled a wide range of DIY projects, including remodeling a bathroom entirely on his own in two weeks, and building a roof deck that hasn't fallen down yet. You can find him on Bluesky.

This is Streamalikes, where you can find a curated list of recommendations to stream based on what you already like.

Diungkapkan bahwa marvel’s forays into television have had varying success, but they hit gold with wandvision and agatha all along, leaning into real pathos while exploring the kind of out-there ideas that thrill comic book fans (and set up the larger film arcs). That streak continues with VisionQuest, in which White Vision (Paul Bettany) struggles to understand his existence in the wake of his death at the hands of Thanos and resurrection at the magic of the Scarlet Witch, while also evading evil androids and assassins, while also dealing with the many, many AIs he’s got locked up in his Mindspace (including a gloriously shabby version of Ultron, played by James Spader).

If you love the show (and you’ve checked out the other series that play in the same sandbox), it’s time to switch gears and watch (or re-watch) The Matrix.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the matrix is one of the most well-known sci-fi films of all time, of course, but it remains incredibly fresh and exciting nearly thirty years after its release. Along with sequels The Matrix: Reloaded, The Matrix: Revolutions, and The Matrix: Resurrections, The Matrix universe offers a story that VisionQuest fans will love, one that includes lushly imagined virtual worlds, questions surrounding existence and consciousness, and the ultimate question of our responsibility as sentient beings (whether we’re organic, programmed, or summoned via magic).

Diungkapkan bahwa you know the basics—at some point in the future, artificially intelligent machines rebel against their creators, win the war, and transform humans into a power source, keeping them docile by inserting their consciousness into a virtual world called the matrix, which resembles 1990s chicago. One such human, Thomas Anderson (Keanu Reeves) is prophesied to be The One, the human who will turn the Matrix against its makers and free humanity. When he’s in the virtual world, Anderson is Neo, and he slowly gains incredible powers as he learns to hack the artificial environment around him.

Berdasarkan laporan, it’s heavier, denser, and more action-oriented than visionquest (the film invented bullet time, after all), but the matrix and its sequels explore similar themes and offer similarly eye-popping visuals. The questions of whether a machine (or an artificial intelligence) can be sentient and truly care about the entities around it are the same, really, and the Agents that Neo and his allies have to battle against in The Matrix bring the same kind of menace as Vision's foes Jocasta (T'Nia Miller) and the Paladin (Todd Stashwick). Hugo Weaving’s Agent Smith likewise delivers the same vibe of cold, disinterested superiority as Spader’s Ultron.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the matrix has a bigger budget and puts a lot of it into spectacular action and special effects sequences that visionquest can’t quite match. But the two narratives share an exploration of identity, a questioning of reality, and the nature of artificial intelligences within a smart sci-fi setting. In short, The Matrix is the ideal follow-up when you finish the series. Rent The Matrix on Prime Video.

Need more films that explore virtual worlds, artificial beings, and deep existential questions? Look no further—here are some more movies that fit the bill.

Sebagaimana diketahui, heavy on the existential questions about sentience and light on speculative action, her is a mumblecore sci-fi masterpiece. Samantha has the ability to evolve and grow, and as their relationship deepens, she becomes more complex, independent, and powerful, eventually evolving into something wholly new. Just like Vision, Samantha is a sentient artificial entity that is figuring out its existence while we watch. In a near future not too dissimilar from our present, Theodore Twombly (Joaquin Phoenix) is a lonely man on the cusp of divorce who begins using (and training) an AI he names Samantha (voiced by Scarlett Johansson). Rent Her on Prime Video.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if the idea of androids fighting for their sovereignty is what excites you about visionquest, definitely check out ex machina. Caleb Smith (Domhnall Gleeson) is brought to the remote lab of his company’s CEO (Oscar Isaac) to determine if the humanoid robot he’s created, named Ava (Alicia Vikander), passes the Turing Test for true sentience. Things go wildly off the rails, but before they do, the film sinks into many of the same philosophical questions that VisionQuest explores as Ava manipulates Caleb into helping her escape. It’s a darker and more violent story than VisionQuest, but fans of the series will love it. Stream Ex Machina on The Roku Channel or Hulu, or rent it on Prime Video.

Berdasarkan laporan, if it’s the fuzzy parent-child relationship between vision and tommy that pulls you into visionquest, check out the creator. Eventually, he finds himself on the run with a powerful “simulant” in the form of a young child named Alphie (Madeleine Yuna Voyles). After a rogue AI detonates a nuclear weapon over Los Angeles, most of the world bans artificial intelligences, and Joshua Taylor (John David Washington) goes undercover to infiltrate an AI architect’s base. The strange parent-child bond that emerges between Taylor and Alphie as he seeks to understand what’s right and what’s necessary is exactly what fans of the show will love. Stream The Creator on Hulu or rent it on Prime Video.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in visionquest, white vision has all of his memories—but as data, not as lived, emotional experiences. Those two words definitely describe After Yang, a story about a family that fights to save the artificial companion they bought for their adopted daughter when it malfunctions. That makes his efforts to understand his existence and his responsibility to the boy who might be a version of his son (it’s complicated) poignant and moving. Over the course of the film, the inhuman Yang becomes defined by the memories contained in its core, and the question of whether an artificial intelligence can truly matter to humans is answered with a resounding yes. Stream After Yang on The Roku Channel or Kanopy, or rent it on Prime Video.

Sebagaimana diketahui, no discussion of artificial life and sentience is complete without mentioning blade runner. Like Vision, he has implanted memories that offer him comfort and context for his life, but he’s not sure if he can accept them as truly his own. While the 1982 original is a classic, the 2017 sequel is a better thematic and visual match to VisionQuest. Plus, the film offers lush visuals and Harrison Ford reprising his role in the original film, so you simply can’t go wrong. Officer K (Ryan Gosling) is a replicant, an artificial being with built-in limitations, who wants to be recognized as a person, a being with a soul. Rent Blade Runner 2049 on Prime Video.

#627. 10 Hacks for the Contacts App Every Apple User Should Know

📅 30 Oct 2026

10 Hacks for the Contacts App Every Apple User Should Know

Tanggal: 30 Oct 2026 | Sumber: https://lifehacker.com/tech/best-contacts-app-hacks?utm_medium=RSS

Berdasarkan laporan, the contacts app is the bedrock of all my communication on my iphone, and to a large extent, also on my macbook. On the surface, Contacts appears to be a basic app that stores names, numbers, and other things you want to remember about people or businesses. However, it has some great features hidden under the surface, such as the ability to quickly delete duplicate contacts, smart lists, and faster ways to bulk share or delete contacts. Here are the 10 best Contacts app hacks for iPhone, iPad, and Mac:.

Diungkapkan bahwa if you have the same number or email address saved under multiple contacts, you can easily clear these from your iphone. iOS shows you a prompt at the top of the list of contacts that lets you remove duplicate contacts easily. Then, click Look for Duplicates. The same feature is hidden in the Mac version of Contacts. To try it, open Contacts on the Mac, and select the Card menu at the top of the screen. This will identify duplicate contacts for you, and you can quickly merge or delete them.

Berdasarkan laporan, it's pretty easy to select multiple entries when you use the contacts app on the mac. You can hold the Shift or Ctrl buttons and use arrow keys or click multiple contacts to select them all. Once you get the gesture right, you'll be able to select multiple contacts quickly. After you select one batch of contacts, you can scroll up or down and use the same gesture to add more contacts to your selection. You need to use two fingers and swipe upwards or downwards on the list of contacts. On your iPhone or iPad, this feature is available via a hidden gesture. This is the fastest way to execute bulk actions in your iPhone's Contacts app.

Sebagaimana diketahui, when you share a contact, ios shows you a prompt to select the fields you wish to send. To try it, open the Contacts app and scroll till you see the contact's name. If you want a faster way to send a contact on your iPhone, you can copy and paste it in the Messages app. Hold the contact's name and press Copy. Open Messages, paste it in any chat, and send it. However, this extra step adds a little bit of friction while sharing contacts. This is great for privacy because you don't want to send your partner's home address, birthdate, your anniversary, nicknames, or other personal details by default. Unfortunately, this doesn't work with third-party messaging apps like WhatsApp, but it's great for texts and iMessage.

Sebagaimana diketahui, on your iphone, you can use contacts to message people on whatsapp, signal, telegram, or other apps. WhatsApp doesn't have access to my contacts, which makes it a bit annoying to message people I know. Just open a contact and hold the messaging button. This will reveal a list of apps where you can ping that person. Since I started using the Contacts app to start chats on WhatsApp, the process of pinging new people has become a lot faster.

Berdasarkan laporan, just as you can use contacts to message people on third-party apps, you can also use it to call them on those apps. Go to any contact in the Contacts app on your iPhone, and hold the call button. This will let you call them on WhatsApp, Signal, or any other apps where their phone number is linked.

Sebagaimana diketahui, ios makes it hard to delete contacts quickly. To speed this up, open Contacts on your iPhone and hold any contact's name. In the popover menu, select Delete to remove the contact. To remove multiple contacts quickly, use the two-finger swipe gesture to select multiple contacts, and hold any of the selected contacts. This prevents accidental deletions, but it can be annoying when you just want to remove people who you last spoke to in high school. In the popover menu, you can select Delete X Contacts, where X is the number of contacts you've selected.

Berdasarkan laporan, to export your entire address book, you can use the contacts app on your mac. You also have the option to export contacts as a PDF file. This will save all your contacts in a vcf file, and you can import that into Google Contacts or other apps or services. Once you have it open, go to File > Export > Export vCard. Just select File > Export as PDF to get it done.

Diungkapkan bahwa when you create a new contact on your mac, the app shows multiple fields that you may never use. If you just need to save phone numbers and email addresses, you can delete all the other blank fields from the template. To do this, open Contacts on your Mac, and go to Card > Add Field > Edit Template to add or remove fields from the default contact template.

Diungkapkan bahwa if you added a number recently, such as a salesperson at a car dealership, but forgot their name, the contacts app doesn't make it easy to find the contact. Instead of scrolling through the entire list of contacts and trying to guess which one could be the person you spoke to, you can use the Contacts app on your Mac to locate them quickly. You can then add the number of days, such as 10 days, in the final field, and click OK. Open Contacts on your Mac, and go to File > New Smart List. It lets you create smart lists to sort contacts by recently added. Now select Card in the first drop-down menu, followed by has changed in for the second one. Click the newly created smart list in the left pane, and you'll see all contacts that were either created or updated in the last 10 days, which will include the hypothetical car salesperson.

Sebagaimana diketahui, smart lists also allow you to quickly create groups of related contacts. For instance, I've saved all my former colleagues' details with the company name in the contact. To find them all quickly, I created a smart list that groups all contacts with that company's name.

Diungkapkan bahwa namedrop is one of my favorite apple features. It lets you bump two Apple devices together to exchange contact information quickly. Hit the Edit button and remove information you don't wish to share. Try holding your iPhone near another person's iPhone, and you'll see a full-screen pop-up asking if you want to share your contact with someone, or if you'd just like to receive their contact information. To protect your privacy, you should limit sending information to others. Open the Contacts app on your iPhone, and tap your name up top. Updating your contact card is the best way to do this. I recommend updating your profile picture too. Instead of sharing a candid photo, you can use an emoji or a professional headshot that you're comfortable sharing in public.

#628. 10 of the Most Iconic Patrick Stewart Roles Beyond Captain Picard

10 of the Most Iconic Patrick Stewart Roles Beyond Captain Picard

Tanggal: 30 Oct 2026 | Sumber: https://lifehacker.com/entertainment/iconic-patrick-stewart-roles-beyond-star-trek?utm_medium=RSS

Diungkapkan bahwa ross johnson writes about television, film, and literature for lifehacker. He has a degree in political science from the University of Rochester and has previously been a legal writer and editor for Thomson Reuters, for which he later traveled around India and the Middle East as an educator specializing in American English style and grammar for adults.

Berdasarkan laporan, ross has been an actor on stage, in commercials, and in independent films since childhood, and has written hundreds of articles and essays on genre literature and cinema for barnes & noble, gizmodo, kotaku, and yahoo! entertainment. Ross produces the Swan Songs film podcast and hosts The Sound of Tomorrow, a pop culture and current affairs radio show based in Rochester, New York, where he lives with his husband and dogs and supports the local arts and cinema scene. You can find him on Bluesky.

Diungkapkan bahwa sir patrick stewart, an actor equally at home onstage at the royal shakespeare company and on the bridge of the starship enterprise, has died at the age of 86. Unexpectedly for most of us, in part because he kept his final illness private, but more so because it once seemed as though nothing could fell the man who looms so large in our cultural consciousness.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the thoughtful, erudite performer who had a troubled childhood in working-class yorkshire; the committed socialist who was eventually knighted by queen elizabeth; the advocate who put his money and his considerable voice toward the fights for lgbtq+ acceptance and animal welfare and against domestic violence, his presence and performances meant the world (the galaxy, even) to myself and so many others. But those who knew him personally can offer better tributes; perhaps it's best left to Shakespeare's Player King, performed by Stewart himself opposite David Warner's Hamlet back in 1965:.

Where joy most revels, grief doth most lament;Grief joys, joy grieves, on slender accident.

Berdasarkan laporan, much of stewart's finest work was on the stage; other performances remain rather shockingly hard to come by (whither i, claudius?). Nonetheless, he left a true legacy behind him, well beyond Captain Picard and Professor X. Here are 10 of his most iconic other roles.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a goofy, feel-good gay rom-com with the hiv/aids crisis still very much in the foreground, jeffrey was a near-impossibility in the mid-1990s: a movie that neither villainized its queers nor treated them as pitiable martyrs. He's the leader of the "Pink Panthers," a squad of queers who defend locals from gay bashers, and that is the key to the character's power: He's as gay as they come, but not ashamed and not even a little weak. Steven Weber and Michael T. This movie, and the presence of Captain Picard himself in it, might have saved my life back in 1995. Weiss are the leads, joined by a cast that includes Christine Baranski, Victor Garber, Nathan Lane, Olympia Dukakis, and Sigourney Weaver but, for all those names, Stewart is the undeniable standout as Sterling, the irrepressible gay best friend: a swishing, mincing, sassy, high-camp character who steals every scene without ever becoming a caricature. Stream Jeffrey on Prime Video, Tubi, and The Roku Channel.

Diungkapkan bahwa a sprawling, epic, and appropriately lusty take on the king arthur stories from john boorman, excalibur is a mixed bag full of stunning visuals and iconic moments that never quite coalesce into something entirely coherent. Standing out among the film's many characters, Stewart is entirely memorable as Leodegrance, the boisterous, boorish, but ultimately faithful father of Guenevere who is among the first to pledge his loyalty to Arthur. Rent Excalibur from Prime Video.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, darcy banker is erudite and intellectual, in his way, and even capable of charm, but otherwise has no redeeming qualities whatsoever. It's even worse when they witness a murder and become trapped in the title's green room, with Stewart as the lead skinhead. He's quite simply one of the all-time great (meaning absolutely terrifying) villains in this thriller that's pretty much a horror movie. It's bad enough for the punk band Ain’t Rights that they've booked a last-minute gig at an Oregon bar without realizing that it's a haven for white supremacists. Stream Green Room on Netflix.

Sebagaimana diketahui, patrick stewart's role as professor xavier in the x-men is almost as pop-culture iconic as that of captain picard, spanning 26 years and nine movies, including the forthcoming avengers: doomsday. We rarely get to see our superheroes at the ends of their days, and there's a lovely bravery to this depiction of the Charles' journey. In most of those, he looks like he's having an awful lot of fun, but he gives his finest performance in the role in this elegaic installment, playing a dying Professor in profound cognitive decline, his dream in tatters and his bravado worn down to prickly dependence. Logan will likely be the toughest of his films to rewatch in the coming days. Stream Logan on Disney+.

Sebagaimana diketahui, this stagey television movie isn't the most sumptuous of the many filmed versions of the dickens story, but you won't be surprised to learn that there are few better portrayals of ebenezer scrooge. It's rather a shame that Patrick Stewart didn't do more Dickens adaptations, since his booming voice and ability to play thoroughly heightened characters without ever resorting to caricature is as valuable as in Shakespeare. Rent A Christmas Carol from Prime Video.

Berdasarkan laporan, famously referred to as that "unknown british shakespearean actor" when starting out on star trek: the next generation, stewart was an associate of the royal shakespeare company for twenty years before his most famous role came along. We do, however, have this impressively mounted modern-dress stage production, in which Stewart plays King Claudius with characteristic brilliance against David Tennant's melancholy prince. As is the way of live theater, much of his career lives on as an essential link in the chain of Shakespeare performances in the twentieth century. but not in a way that we can conveniently stream. Buy Hamlet from Prime Video and Apple TV.

Berdasarkan laporan, as a cinematic actor, stewart's greatest strength was bringing humanity to larger-than-life, even operatic roles, whether they be arthurian knights, dickensian villains, or superheroes. That ability is an absolute necessity if one is going to have any success doing Shakespeare, as Stewart did for decades. Teaching at Juilliard School, with his career winding down, he's confronted with the living embodiment of the past he left behind to pursue his career. The ensuing relationships grow more complex, with the film building to a climax that's surprising and deeply devastating, made all the more so by Stewart's muted, subtle performance. Match is something rather different, though, and it's rather lovely to see him play something just a bit more mundane—even if the film's Tobi Powell is a choreographer with a nearly legendary reputation. Stream Match on AMC+.

Diungkapkan bahwa this is not the greatest mel brooks movie, not by a long shot, but it is a great comedic performance from patrick stewart. He loved to recount, with self-effacing embarrassment, the story of having shouted "We are not here to have fun" at his co-workers during a rowdy day on set at Star Trek: The Next Generation. By 1993, he was clearly past any such pomposity, and clearly having fun in his cameo as King Richard, a memorably silly take on a character he might well have played with seriousness elsewhere. Rent Robin Hood: Men in Tights from Prime Video.

Berdasarkan laporan, stewart's first real foray into science fiction was in this big, bold, divisive, and thoroughly bonkers frank herbert adaptation from director david lynch. Stewart plays troubadour and warrior Gurney Halleck, and does what he does best: bringing gravitas and believability (and it must be said, bald sexiness) to even the wildest material. Stream Dune on Tubi.

Berdasarkan laporan, stewart plays an aged merlin in this rather shockingly good modern reimagining of the king arthur legendarium. His Merlin is all wild hair and rock band T-shirts, possessed of an essential kindness that makes him a valued mentor, and one deserving of his character's poignant farewell at the film's conclusion. Stream The Kid Who Would Be King on Disney+ and Prime Video.

Sebagaimana diketahui, pradershika sharma is a tech deals writer for lifehacker. Ed. She has a Master’s degree in English Literature, a B. Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, amazon currently has the 32-inch samsung odyssey oled g8 (g80sh) for $999. 99, down from $1,299. 99, and price trackers show that this is its lowest price so far. This is the newer 4K OLED model, not Samsung’s similarly named G80HS, which is a 6K IPS variant, and it makes the most sense for someone who wants one screen for both high-end gaming and everyday desktop use without moving to a larger ultrawide.

Sebagaimana diketahui, its 4k qd-oled panel runs at 240hz, which gives the g80sh enough speed for competitive shooters and racing games while still keeping slower, more cinematic games looking sharp. You will need a powerful PC to get anywhere close to 4K at 240Hz, but the monitor is at least equipped for newer graphics hardware with DisplayPort 2. It also has USB-C with up to 98W of power delivery, so if this monitor doubles as a work setup, a compatible laptop can send video and charge over the same cable instead of adding another wire to your desk. 1 and HDMI 2. 1. FreeSync Premium Pro and G-SYNC compatibility should also help keep tearing under control, though OLED monitors can still show visible VRR flicker in darker scenes when frame pacing is inconsistent.

Berdasarkan laporan, the bigger visual difference, though, shows up in darker games and hdr content, where blacks stay properly black and bright effects stand out without the blooming you often see on lcd monitors. That said, QD-OLED does have its own drawbacks, since blacks can take on a purplish tint in a brightly lit room, while burn-in remains a long-term concern—though Samsung does include active cooling and several screen-protection features to reduce uneven wear and says burn-in from normal use is covered under warranty. If you mostly play at lower frame rates or do not care much about OLED contrast, this is probably more monitor than you need, but for someone with the graphics hardware to take advantage of 4K at 240Hz, this discount makes the G80SH much easier to justify.
